Berakhot 32b:26-33a:2: Afillu hammelech shoel bishlomo lo yeshivennu.
Amar rav yosef, lo shanu ella lemalche yisrael, aval lemalche ummot haolam — posek.
Metivi: hammitpallel veraa annas ba kenegdo, raa karon ba kenegdo — lo yehe mafsik, ella mekatztzer veole!
La kashya, ha deefshar lekatztzer (yekatztzer. veim lav — posek).

Tanu rabbanan: maase bechasid echad shehaya mitpallel badderech. ba hegmon echad venatan lo shalom, velo hechzir lo shalom. himtin lo ad shessiyyem tefillato. leachar shessiyyem tefillato, amar lo: reka, vahalo katuv betoratchem "rak hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha", uchetiv "venishmartem meod lenafshotechem". keshennatatti lecha shalom lamma lo hechzarta li shalom? im hayiti chotech roshcha besayif, mi haya tovea et damcha miyyadi?!
Amar lo: hameten li ad sheafayyescha bidvarim. amar lo: illu hayita omed lifne melech basar vadam, uva chavercha venatan lecha shalom — hayita

Machazir lo?! amar lo: lav. veim hayita machazir lo, ma hayu osim lecha? amar lo: hayu chotchim et roshi besayif. amar lo: vahalo devarim kal vachomer, uma atta shehayita omed lifne melech basar vadam, shehayyom kan umachar bakkever — kach ani shehayiti omed lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu, shehu chay vekayyaym laad uleolme olamim — al achat kamma vechamma.
Miyyad nitpayyes oto hegmon, veniftar oto chasid leveto leshalom.
Chullin 91a:19-91b:7: Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lamma nikra shemo gid hannashe? shennasha mimmekomo veala, vechen hu omer: "nashta gevuratam hayu lenashim".
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "davar shalach beyaakov venafal beyisrael"? "davar shalach beyaakov" – ze gid hannashe, "venafal beyisrael" – sheppashat issuro bechol yisrael.
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "utevoach tevach vehachen"? pera lahen bet hashshechita, "vehachen" – tol gid hannashe bifnehem, keman deamar gid hannashe neesar livne noach.

"Vayyivvater yaakov levaddo", amar rabbi elazar: shennishtayyer al pakkin ketannim, mikkan latztzaddikim shechaviv alehem mamonam yoter miggufam, vechol kach lamma? lefi sheen poshtin yedehen begazel.
"Vayyeavek ish immo ad alot hashshachar", amar rabbi yitzchak: mikkan letalmid chacham shello yetze yechidi ballayla. rabbi abba bar kahana amar mehacha:
Rabbi avahu amar mehacha: "vayyashkem avraham babboker vayyachavosh et vegomer".
Verabbanan amri mehacha: "lech na ree et shelom achecha veet shelom vegomer".

Amar rabbi akiva: shaalti et rabban gamliel veet rabbi yehoshua baitliz shel imaum, shehalchu likkach behema lemishte veno shel rabban gamliel. ketiv "vayyizrach lo hashshemesh", vechi shemesh lo levad zarcha? vahalo lechol haolam zarcha!

Amar rabbi yitzchak: shemesh habbaa baavuro zarcha baavuro, dichtiv: "vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana", uchetiv: "vayyifga bammakom". ki meta lecharan amar: efshar avarti al makom shehitpallelu avotay vaani lo hitpallalti? kad yahev dateh lemihdar, kefatza leh ara, miyyad – "vayyifga bammakom".
Kad tzalli, bae lemehdar, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: tzaddik ze ba levet meloni, veyippater belo lina? miyyad, "ba hashshemesh".
Eruvin 102b:9-13: Gemara tanu rabbanan: retiyya sheppersha meal gabbe makka — machzirin beshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer: huchelka lematta — dochakah lemala, lemala — dochakah lematta, umegalle miktzat hartiyya umekanneach pi hammakka, vechozer umegalle miktzat retiyya umekanneach pi hammakka.
Uretiyya atzmah lo yekanneach, mippene shehu memareach. veim merach — chayyayv chattat.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda. amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella sheppersha al gabbe keli, aval persha al gabbe karka — divre hakkol asur.

Amar mar bar rav ashe: hava kaemna kammeh abba, nefala leh abbe sadya, veka mahdar leh. amena leh: la savar la mar leha deamar rav chisda: machloket sheppersha al gabbe keli, aval persha al gabbe karka — asur, veamar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda!
Amar li: la shemia li, kelomar la sevira li.
Gittin 6b:15-7a:7: Amar rav chisda: leolam al yatil adam ema yetera betoch beto, shehare pilegesh baggiva hetil aleha baalah ema yetera, vehippila kamma revavot miyyisrael.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hammetil ema yetera betoch beto, sof hu ba lide shalosh averot: gilluy arayot, ushefichut damim, vechillul shabbat.
Amar rabba bar bar chana: ha deamri rabbanan: shelosha devarim tzarich adam lomar betoch beto erev shabbat im chashecha: issartem? eravtem? hadeliku et hanner! tzarich
Lememrinhu benichuta, ki hechi delikabbelu minneh. amar rav ashe: ana la shemia li ha derabba bar bar chana, vekiyyaymtiha missevara.
Amar rabbi avahu: leolam al yatil adam ema yetera betoch beto, shehare adam gadol hetil ema yetera betoch beto veheechiluhu davar gadol.
Umannu? rabbi chanina ben gamliel. heechiluhu salka datach?! hasheta behemtan shel tzaddikim en hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yadam, tzaddikim atzman lo kol shekken?
Ella bikkeshu lehaachilo davar gadol. umay nihu? ever min hachay.
Shelach leh mar ukeva lerabbi elazar: bene adam haomdim alay, uveyadi lemosram lammalchut, mahu?
Sirtet uchetav leh: "amarti eshmera derachay mechato vilshoni eshmera lefi machsom beod rasha lenegdi" – af al pi sherasha lenegdi, eshmera lefi machsom.

Shelach leh: ka metzaari li tuva, vela matzena deekum behu. shelach leh: "dom laAdonai vehitcholel lo" – dom laAdonai, vehu yappilem lecha chalalim chalalim; hashekem vehaarev alehen levet hammidrash, vehen kalin meelehen. haddavar yatza mippi rabbi elazar, unetanuhu ligniva bekolar.

Mishnah Eruvin 10:1-4:
Hammotze tefillin, machnisan zug zug. rabban gamliel omer, shenayim shenayim. bamme devarim amurim, bishanot, aval bachadashot, patur. metzaan tzevatim o cherichot, machshich alehen umevian. uvassakkana, mechassan veholech lo: 
Rabbi shimon omer, notnan lachavero, vachavero lachavero, ad shemmaggia lechatzer hachitzona. vechen beno, notno lachavero, vachavero lachavero, afillu mea. rabbi yehuda omer, noten adam chavit lachavero, vachavero lachavero, afillu chutz lattechum. amru lo, lo tehallech zo yoter meragle vealeha: 
Haya kore vassefer al haaskuppa, nitgalgel hassefer miyyado, gollo etzlo. haya kore verosh haggag venitgalgel hassefer miyyado, ad shello higgia laasara tefachim, gollo etzlo. mishshehiggia laasara tefachim, hofcho al hakketav. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu en mesullak min haaretz ella chimlo machat, gollo etzlo. rabbi shimon omer, afillu vaaretz atzmo gollo etzlo, sheen lecha davar mishshum shevut omed bifne chitve hakkodesh: 
Ziz shellifne challon, notnin alav venotlin mimmennu veshabbat. omed adam birshut hayyachid umetaltel birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim umetaltel birshut hayyachid, uvilvad shello yotzi chutz mearba ammot:
Mishnah Eruvin 7:10-8:2:
Bakkol mearvin umishtattefin, chutz min hammayim umin hammelach, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, kikkar hu eruv. afillu maafe sea vehi ferusa, en mearvin bah. kikkar beissar vehu shalem, mearvin bo: 
Noten adam maa lechenvani ulenachtom kede sheyyizke lo eruv, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, lo zachu lo meotav. umodim bishar kol adam shezzachu lo meotav, sheen mearvin leadam ella middato. amar rabbi yehuda, bamme devarim amurim, beeruve techumin, aval beeruve chatzerot, mearvin ledato veshello ledato, lefi shezzachin leadam shello befanav, veen chavin leadam shello befanav: 
Ketzad mishtattefin battechumin. meniach et hechavit veomer, hare ze lechol bene iri, lechol mi sheyyelech levet haevel o levet hammishte. vechol shekkibbel alav mibbeod yom, muttar. mishshettechshach, asur, sheen mearvin mishshettechshach: 
Kamma hu shiuro, mezon shete seudot lechol echad. mezono lechol velo leshabbat, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, leshabbat velo lechol. veze vaze mitkavvenin lehakel. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, mikkikkar befundeyon, mearba sein besela. rabbi shimon omer, shete yadot lechikkar mishshalosh lekav. chetzyah levayit hamenugga, vachatzi chetzyah lifsol et haggeviyya:
Mishnah Eruvin 7:5-9:
Matben shebben shete chatzerot, gavoah asara tefachim, mearvin shenayim veen mearvin echad. ellu maachilin mikkan veellu maachilin mikkan. nitmaet hatteven measara tefachim, mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim: 
Ketzad mishtattefin bammavoy. meniach et hechavit veomer, hare zo lechol bene mavoy, umezakke lahen al yede veno uvitto haggedolim veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim veal yede ishto, aval eno mezakke lo al yede veno uvitto hakketannim velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, mippene sheyyadan keyado: 
Nitmaet haochel, mosif umezakke, veen tzarich lehodia. nittosfu alehem, mosif umezakke, vetzarich lehodia: 
Kamma hu shiuro. bizman shehen merubbin, mezon shete seudot lechullam. bizman shehen muatin, kigrogeret lehotzaat shabbat lechol echad veechad: 
Amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim, bitchillat eruv. aval bishyare eruv, kol shehu. velo amru learev bachatzerot ella chede shello leshakkeach et hattinokot:
Mishnah Eruvin 8:3-6:
Anshe chatzer veanshe mirpeset sheshshachchu velo ervu, kol sheggavoah asara tefachim, lammirpeset. pachot mikkan, lechatzer. chulyat habbor vehassela, gevohim asara tefachim, lammirpeset. pachot mikkan, lechatzer. bamme devarim amurim, bismucha. aval bemufleget, afillu gavoah asara tefachim, lechatzer. veezo hi semucha, kol sheenah rechoka arbaa tefachim: 
Hannoten et eruvo bevet shaar, achsadra umirpeset, eno eruv. vehaddar sham, eno oser alav. bevet hatteven uvevet habbakar uvevet haetzim uvevet haotzarot, hare ze eruv. vehaddar sham, oser alav. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh sham tefisat yad shel baal habbayit, eno oser alav: 
Hammanniach beto vehalach lishbot beir acheret, echad nachri veechad yisrael, hare ze oser, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, eno oser. rabbi yose omer, nachri oser, yisrael eno oser, sheen derech yisrael lavo veshabbat. rabbi shimon omer, afillu hinniach beto vehalach lishbot etzel bitto veotah hair, eno oser, shekkevar hissia millibbo: 
Bor shebben shete chatzerot, en memallein mimmennu veshabbat, ella im ken asu lo mechitztza gavoah asara tefachim ben milmala, ben millematta, ben mittoch ogno. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, bet shammay omrim, millematta. uvet hillel omrim, milmala. amar rabbi yehuda, lo tehe mechitztza gedola min hakkotel shebbenehem:
Mishnah Eruvin 8:7-11:
Ammat hammayim shehi overet bechatzer, en memallein hemenna veshabbat, ella im ken asu lah mechitztza gavoah asara tefachim bakkenisa uvaytzia. rabbi yehuda omer, kotel sheal gabbah tiddon mishshum mechitztza. amar rabbi yehuda, maase vaamma shel avel shehayu memallein mimmenna al pi zekenim beshabbat. amru lo, mippene shello haya vah kashshiur: 
Gezuztera shehi lemala min hammayim, en memallein hemenna veshabbat, ella im ken asu lah mechitztza gavoah asara tefachim, ben milmala ben millematta. vechen shete gezuzteraot zo lemala mizzo. asu laelyona velo asu lattachtona, shetehen asurot ad sheyyearevu: 
Chatzer shehi fechuta mearba ammot, en shofchin betochah mayim beshabbat, ella im ken asu lah uka machazeket satayim min hannekev ulematta, ben mibbachutz ben mibbifnim, ella shemmibbachutz tzarich likmor, mibbifnim en tzarich likmor: 
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, biv shehu kamur arba ammot birshut harabbim, shofchin letocho mayim beshabbat. vachachamim omrim, afillu gag o chatzer mea amma, lo yishpoch al pi habbiv, aval shofech miggag legag, vehammayim yordin labbiv. hechatzer vehaachsadra mitztarfin learba ammot: 
Vechen shete deyotaot zo cheneged zo, miktzatan asu uka umiktzatan lo asu uka, et sheasu uka, muttarin, veet shello asu uka, asurin:
Mishnah Eruvin 9:1-4:
Kol gaggot hair, reshut achat, uvilvad shello yehe gag gavoah asara o namoch asara, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, kol echad veechad reshut bifne atzmo. rabbi shimon omer, echad gaggot veechad chatzerot veechad karpefot, reshut echad lakkelim sheshshavtu letochan, velo lakkelim sheshshavtu vetoch habbayit: 
Gag gadol samuch lekatan, haggadol muttar vehakkatan asur. chatzer gedola shennifretza liktanna, gedola mutteret, uketanna asura, mippene shehi chefitchah shel gedola. chatzer shennifretza lirshut harabbim, hammachnis mittochah lirshut hayyachid, o mershut hayyachid letochah, chayyav, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, mittochah lirshut harabbim, o mershut harabbim letochah, patur, mippene shehi kecharmelit: 
Chatzer shennifretza lirshut harabbim mishshete ruchoteha, vechen bayit shennifratz mishshete ruchotav, vechen mavoy shennittelu korotav o lechayav, muttarin beoto shabbat vaasurin leatid lavo, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, im muttarin leoto shabbat, muttarin leatid lavo. veim asurin leatid lavo, asurin leoto shabbat: 
Habbone aliyya al gabbe shene vattim, vechen gesharim hamefullashim, metaltelin tachtehen beshabbat, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim osrin. veod amar rabbi yehuda, mearvin lemavoy hamefullash. vachachamim osrin:
Mishnah Makkot 1:1-4:
Ketzad haedim naasim zommin, meidin anu veish peloni shehu ven gerusha o ven chalutza, en omrim yease ze ven gerusha o ven chalutza tachtav, ella loke arbaim. meidin anu veish peloni shehu chayyav liglot, en omrim yigle ze tachtav, ella loke arbaim. meidin anu veish peloni sheggerash et ishto velo natan lah ketubbatah, vahalo ben hayyom uven lemachar sofo litten lah ketubbatah, omdin kamma adam rotze litten bichtubbatah shel zo, sheim nitalmena o nitgarsha, veim meta yirashenna valah. meidin anu veish peloni shehu chayyav lachavero elef zuz al menat littenan lo mikkan vead sheloshim yom, vehu omer mikkan vead eser shanim, omdin kamma adam rotze litten veyihyu veyado elef zuz, ben notnan mikkan vead sheloshim yom, ben notnan mikkan vead eser shanim: 
Meidin anu veish peloni shechayyav lachavero matayim zuz, venimtzeu zommin, lokin umeshallemin, shello hashshem hamevio lide makkot, mevio lide tashlumin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, kol hameshallem eno loke: 
Meidin anu veish peloni shehu chayyav malkut arbaim, venimtzeu zommin, lokin shemonim, mishshum lo taane vereacha ed shaker (Shemot 20), umishshum vaasitem lo kaasher zamam (Devarim 19), divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, enan lokin ella arbaim. meshalleshin bemamon veen meshalleshin bemakkot. ketzad, heiduhu shehu chayyav lachavero matayim zuz, venimtzeu zommin, meshalleshin benehem. aval im heiduhu shehu chayyav malkut arbaim, venimtzeu zommin, kol echad veechad loke arbaim: 
En haedim naasim zommin ad sheyyazomu et atzman. ketzad, amru meidin anu veish peloni sheharag et hannefesh, amru lahen heach attem meidin, shehare neherag ze o hahoreg haya immanu oto hayyom bemakom peloni, en ellu zommin. aval amru lahem heach attem meidin, shehare attem heyitem immanu oto hayyom bemakom peloni, hare ellu zommin, veneheragin al pihem:
Mishnah Makkot 1:5-8:
Bau acherim vehizzimum, bau acherim vehizzimum, afillu mea, kullam yeharegu. rabbi yehuda omer, istasit hi zo, veenah nehereget ella chat harishona vilvad: 
En haedim zommin neheragin, ad sheyyiggamer haddin, shehare hatztzedokin omrim, ad sheyyehareg, shenneemar nefesh tachat nafesh. amru lahem chachamim, vahalo chevar neemar (Devarim 19) vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv, vahare achiv kayyam. veim ken lamma neemar nefesh tachat nafesh, yachol mishshaa shekkibbelu edutan yeharegu, talmud lomar, nefesh tachat nafesh, ha enan neheragin ad sheyyiggamer haddin: 
Al pi shenayim edim o shelosha edim yumat hammet (sham 17), im mitkayyemet haedut bishnayim, lamma farat hakkatuv bishlosha, ella lehakkish shelosha lishnayim, ma shelosha mazzimin et hashshenayim, af hashshenayim yazommo et hashshelosha. uminnayin afillu mea, talmud lomar, edim. rabbi shimon omer, ma shenayim enan neheragin ad sheyyehu shenehem zommin, af shelosha enan neheragin ad sheyyihyu shelashtan zommin. uminnayin afillu mea, talmud lomar, edim. rabbi akiva omer, lo va hashshelishi ella lehachemir alav velaasot dino chayyotze vaellu. veim ken anash hakkatuv lannitpal leovre avera cheovre avera, al achat kamma vechamma yeshallem sachar lannitpal leose mitzva cheose mitzva: 
Ma shenayim nimtza achad mehen karov o fasul edutan betela, af shelosha nimtza echad mehen karov o fasul, edutan betela. minnayin afillu mea, talmud lomar, edim. amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim, bedine nefashot. aval bedine mamonot, titkayyem haedut bashshear. rabbi omer, echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot. bizman shehitru vahen, aval bizman shello hitru vahen, ma yaasu shene achin sherau veechad sheharag et hannafesh:
Mishnah Makkot 1:9-2:3:
Hayu shenayim roin oto mechallon ze ushenayim roin oto mechallon ze veechad matre vo baemtza, bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu, hare ellu edut achat. veim lav, hare ellu shete eduyyot. lefichach im nimtzet achat mehen zomemet, hu vahen neheragin vehashsheniyya petura. rabbi yose omer, leolam en neheragin ad sheyyehu pi shene edav matrin bo, shenneemar (Devarim 17) al pi shenayim edim. davar acher, al pi shenayim edim, shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi hatturgeman: 
Mi shennigmar dino uvarach uva lifne oto vet din, en sotrim et dino. kol makom sheyyaamdu shenayim veyomru, meidin anu veish peloni shennigmar dino bevet dino shel peloni, ufeloni ufeloni edav, hare ze yehareg. sanhedrin noheget baaretz uvechutza laaretz. sanhedrin hahoreget echad beshavua nikret chavlanit. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, echad leshivim shana. rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva omrim, illu hayinu vassanhedrin lo neherag adam meolam. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af hen marbin shofche damim beyisrael: 
Ellu hen haggolin, hahoreg nefesh bishgaga. haya meaggel bemagila venafla alav vaharagattu, haya meshalshel bechavit venafla alav vaharagattu, haya yored besullam venafal alav vaharago, hare ze gole. aval im haya moshech bemagila venafla alav vaharagattu, haya dole vechavit venifsak hachevel venafla alav vaharagattu, haya ole vesullam venafal alav vaharago, hare ze eno gole. ze hakkelal, kol shebbederech yeridato, gole. veshello vederech yeridato, eno gole. nishmat habbarzel mikkatto veharag, rabbi omer, eno gole. vachachamim omrim, gole. min haetz hammitbakkea, rabbi omer, gole. vachachamim omrim, eno gole: 
Hazzorek even lirshut harabbim veharag, hare ze gole. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, im mikkesheyyatzta haeven miyyado hotzi hallaz et rosho vekibbelah, hare ze fatur. zarak et haeven lachatzero veharag, im yesh reshut lannizzak likkanes lesham, gole. veim lav, eno gole, shenneemar (Devarim 19) vaasher yavo et reehu vayyaar, ma hayyaar reshut lannizzak velammazzik likkanes lesham, yatza chatzar baal habbayit sheen reshut lannizzak velammazzik likkanes lesham. abba shaul omer, ma chatavat etzim reshut, yatza haav hammakke et beno, veharav harode et talmido, usheliach bet din: 
Haav gole al yede habben, vehabben gole al yede haav. hakkol golin al yede yisrael, veyisrael golin al yedehen, chutz meal yede ger toshav. veger toshav eno gole ella al yede ger toshav. hassuma eno gole, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, gole. hassone eno gole. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer, hassone neherag, mippene shehu chemuad. rabbi shimon omer, yesh sone gole veyesh sone sheeno gole. ze hakkelal, kol shehu yachol lomar ledaat harag, eno gole. veshello ledaat harag, hare ze gole:
Mishnah Makkot 2:4-7:
Lehechan golin, leare miklat. lashshalosh shebbeever hayyarden velashshalosh shebbeeretz kenaan, shenneemar (Bamidbar la) et shelosh hearim tittenu meever layyarden veet shelosh hearim tittenu beeretz kenaan vegomer. ad shello nivcharu shalosh shebbeeretz yisrael, lo hayu shalosh shebbeever hayyarden koltot, shenneemar (sham) shesh are miklat tihyena, ad sheyyihyu sheshtan koltot keechad: 
Umechuvvanot lahen derachim mizzo lazo, shenneemar (Devarim 19) tachin lecha hadderech veshillashta vegomer. umosrin lahen shene talmide chachamim, shemma yahargennu vadderech, vidabberu elav. rabbi meir omer, af hu medabber al yede atzmo, shenneemar (sham) veze devar harotzeach: 
Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer, battechilla, echad shogeg veechad mezid makdimin leare miklat, uvet din sholchin umeviin oto mishsham. mi shennitchayyev mita bevet din, haraguhu. veshello nitchayyev mita, petaruhu. mi shennitchayyev galut, machazirin oto limkomo, shenneemar (Bamidbar la) veheshivu oto haeda el ir miklato vegomer. echad mashuach beshemen hammishcha veechad hamerubbe vivgadim veechad sheavar mimmeshichato, machazirin et harotzeach. rabbi yehuda omer, af meshuach milchama machazir et harotzeach. lefichach immotehen shel kohanim mesappekot lahen michya uchesut, kede shello yitpallelu al benehem sheyyamutu. mishshennigmar dino met kohen gadol, hare ze eno gole. im ad shello nigmar dino met kohen gadol uminnu acher tachtav, uleachar mikken nigmar dino, chozer bemitato shel sheni: 
Nigmar dino velo chohen gadol, hahoreg kohen gadol, vechohen gadol sheharag, eno yotze mishsham leolam. veeno yotze lo leedut mitzva velo leedut mamon velo leedut nefashot. vaafillu yisrael tzerichim lo, vaafillu sar tzeva yisrael keyoav ben tzeruya, eno yotze mishsham leolam, shenneemar (Bamidbar la) asher nas shamma, sham tehe dirato, sham tehe mitato, sham tehe kevurato. keshem shehair koletet, kach techumah kolet. rotzeach sheyyatza chutz lattechum umetzao goel haddam, rabbi yose haggelili omer, mitzva veyad goel haddam, ureshut beyad kol adam. rabbi akiva omer, reshut beyad goel haddam, vechol adam en chayyavin alav. ilan shehu omed betoch hattechum venofo note chutz lattechum, o omed chutz lattechum venofo note letoch hattechum, hakkol holech achar hannof. harag beotah hair, gole mishshechuna lishchuna. uven levi, gole meir leir:
Mishnah Makkot 2:8-3:3:
Kayyotze vo, rotzeach sheggala leir miklato veratzu anshe hair lechabbedo, yomar lahem rotzeach ani. amru lo af al pi chen, yekabbel mehen, shenneemar (Devarim 19) veze devar harotzeach. maalim hayu sachar lalviyyim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, lo hayu maalim lahen sachar. vechozer lasserara shehaya vah, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, lo haya chozer lasserara shehaya vah: 
Veellu hen hallokin, habba al achoto, veal achot aviv, veal achot immo, veal achot ishto, veal eshet achiv, veal eshet achi aviv, veal hannidda, almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lenatin ulemamzer. almana ugerusha, chayyavin aleha mishshum shene shemot. gerusha vachalutza, eno chayyav ella mishshem echad bilvad: 
Hattame sheachal et hakkodesh, vehabba el hammikdash tame, vehaochel chelev, vedam, venotar, ufiggul, vetame, hashshochet vehammaale vachutz, vehaochel chametz befesach, vehaochel vehaose melacha beyom hakkippurim, vehamefattem et hashshemen, vehamefattem et hakketoret, vehassach beshemen hammishcha, vehaochel nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim. achal tevel umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. kamma yochal min hattevel vihe chayyav, rabbi shimon omer kol shehu, vachachamim omrim kazzayit. amar lahem rabbi shimon, en attem modim li beochel nemala kol shehu chayyav. amru lo, mippene shehi chivriyyatah. amar lahen, af chitta achat kivriyyatah: 
Haochel bikkurim ad shello kara alehen, kadshe kadashim chutz lakkelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni chutz lachoma, hashshover et haetzem bappesach hattahor, hare ze loke arbaim. aval hammotir battahor vehashshover battame, eno loke arbaim:
Mishnah Makkot 3:4-8:
Hannotel em al habbanim, rabbi yehuda omer, loke veeno meshalleach. vachachamim omrim, meshalleach veeno loke. ze hakkelal, kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase, en chayyavin aleha: 
Hakkoreach karcha verosho, vehammakkif peat rosho, vehammashchit peat zekano, vehassoret serita achat al hammet, chayyav. sarat serita achat al chamishsha metim o chamesh seritot al met echad, chayyav al kol achat veechat. al harosh, shetayim, achat mikkan veachat mikkan. al hazzakan, shetayim mikkan ushetayim mikkan veachat millematta. rabbi eliezer omer, im netalo chullo cheachat, eno chayyav ella echat. veeno chayyav ad sheyyittelennu vetaar. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu likketo vemalket o virhitni, chayyav: 
Hakkotev ketovet kaaka, katav velo kiaka, kiaka velo chatav, eno chayyav, ad sheyyichtov vikaakea bidyo uvichchol uvechol davar shehu roshem. rabbi shimon ben yehuda mishshum rabbi shimon omer, eno chayyav ad sheyyichtov sham hashshem, shenneemar (Vayikra 19) uchetovet kaaka lo tittenu bachem ani Adonai: 
Nazir shehaya shote vayyayin kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tishte al tishte vehu shote, chayyav al kol achat veechat: 
Haya mittamme lemetim kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tittamme, al tittamme, vehaya mittamme, chayyav al kol achat veechat. haya megalleach kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tegalleach al tegalleach vehu megalleach, chayyav al kol achat veechat. haya lavush bechilayim kol hayyom, eno chayyav ella echat. amru lo al tilbash al tilbash vehu foshet velovesh, chayyav al kol achat veechat:
Mishnah Negaim 11:1-4:
Kol habbegadim mittammein bannegaim, chutz mishshel nachrim. hallokeach begadim min hannachrim, yerau vattechilla. veorot hayyam enan mittammein bannegaim. chibber lahem min haggadel baaretz, afillu chut, afillu meshicha, davar shehu mekabbel tuma, tame: 
Tzemer gemallim vetzemer rechelim shetterafan ze vaze, im rov min haggemallim, enam mittammein bannegaim. im rov min harchelim, mittammeim bannegaim. mechetza lemechetza, mittammein bannegaim. vechen happishtan vehakkanbos shetterafan ze vaze: 
Haorot vehabbegadim hatztzevuim, en mittammein bannegaim. habbattim, ben tzevuim ben sheenan tzevuim, mittammein bannegaim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, haorot kabbattim. rabbi shimon omer, hatztzevuim bide shamayim, mittammein. uvide adam, enan mittammein: 
Beged sheshshityo tzavua veerbo lavan, erbo tzavua veshityo lavan, hakkol holech achar hannire. habbegadim mittammein birakrak shebbayrukkim, uvaadamdam shebbaadummim. haya yerakrak ufasa adamdam, adamdam ufasa yerakrak, tame. nishtanna ufasa, nishtanna velo fasa, keillu lo nishtanna. rabbi yehuda omer, yerae vattechilla:
Mishnah Negaim 11:10-12:1:
Nira bashsheti haomed, haarig tahor. nira vaarig, hashsheti haomed tahor. nira vassadin, soref et hannimin. nira vannimin, hassadin tahor. chaluk shennira vo nega, matztzil et haumriyyot shebbo, afillu hen argaman: 
Kol harauy littamme teme met, af al pi sheeno rauy littamme midras, mittamme vannegaim. kegon kela shel sefina, uvilon, veshavis shel sevacha, umitpachot shel sefarim, vegalgillon, uretzuot minal vesandal sheyyesh bahen rochav kaggeris, hare ellu mittammein bannegaim. sagos shennira vo nega, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, ad sheyyerae vaarig uvammochin. hachemet vehatturemal nirin kedarkan, ufose mittocho laachorav umeachorav letocho: 
Beged hammusgar shennitarev baacherim, kullan tehorim. ketzatzo vaasao mochin, tahor, umuttar bahanayato. vehammuchlat shennitarev baacherim, kullam temein. ketzatzo vaasao mochin, tame, veasur bahanayato: 
Kol habbattim mittammein bannegaim, chutz mishshel nachrim. hallokeach battim min hannachrim, yerau vattechilla. bayit agol, bayit terigon, bayit habbanuy bisfina o veaskarya, al arba korot, eno mittamme vannegaim. veim haya merubba, afillu al arbaa ammudim, mittamme:
Mishnah Negaim 11:5-9:
Haomed barishon, yechabbes veyasgir. haomed bashsheni, yissaref. happose vaze uvaze, yissaref. hichha vattechilla, rabbi yishmael omer, yechabbes veyasgir. vachachamim omrim, eno zakuk lo. hichha varishon, yechabbes veyasgir. hichha vashsheni, koro vesoref ma shekkara. vetzarich matlit. rabbi nechemya omer, eno tzarich matlit: 
Chazar nega labbeged, matztzil et hammatlit. chazar lammatlit, soref et habbeged. hattole min hammusgar battahor, chazar nega labbeged, soref et hammatlit. chazar lammatlit, habbeged harishon yissaref, vehammatlit teshammesh et habbeged hashsheni besimanin: 
Kayta sheyyesh bah pispasim tzevuim ulevanim, posin mizze laze. shaalu et rabbi eliezer, vahare hu fispas yachid. amar lahen, lo shamati. amar lo rabbi yehuda ven betera, alammed bo. amar lo, im lekayyem divre chachamim, hen. amar lo, shemma yaamod bo shene shavuot, vehaomed babbegadim shene shavuot tame. amar lo, chacham gadol atta, shekkiyyamta divre chachamim. happisyon hassamuch, kol shehu. harachok, kaggeris. vehachozer, kaggeris: 
Hashsheti vehaerev mittammeim bannegaim miyyad. rabbi yehuda omer, hashsheti, mishsheyyishshalek, vehaerev, miyyad. vehaunin shel pishtan, mishsheyyitlabbenu. kamma yehe vappekaat utehe mittammea vannegaim, kede leerog mimmenna shalosh al shalosh sheti vaerev, afillu chullah sheti, afillu chullah erev. hayta fesikot, enah mittammea vannegaim. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu fesika achat ukesharah, enah mittammea: 
Hammaale min happekaat lachavertah, min hasselil lachavero, min hakkoved haelyona lakkoved hattachtona, vechen shene dappe chaluk shennira nega beachad mehen, hare hashsheni tahor. benefesh hammassechet uvashsheti haomed, hare ellu mittammein bannegaim miyyad. rabbi shimon omer, hashsheti, im haya ratzuf, mittamme:
Mishnah Negaim 12:2-5: Bayit sheachad mitztzedadav mechuppe veshayish, echad besela, veechad bilvenim, veechad beafar, tahor. bayit shello hayu vo avanim veetzim veafar venira vo nega veachar kach heviu vo avanim veetzim veafar, tahor. vechen beged shello arag bo shalosh al shalosh venira vo nega veachar kach arag bo shalosh al shalosh, tahor. en habbayit mittamme vannegaim ad sheyyehe vo avanim veetzim veafar:

Vechamma avanim yehu vo. rabbi yishmael omer, arba. rabbi akiva omer, shemone. shehaya rabbi yishmael omer, ad sheyyerae chishne gerisin al shete avanim o al even echat. rabbi akiva omer, ad sheyyerae chishne gerisin al shete avanim, lo al even echat. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer, ad sheyyerae chishne gerisin al shete avanim bishne chetalim bazzavit, arko kishne gerisin verachbo kaggeris:

Etzim, kede litten tachat hashshekof. rabbi yehuda omer, kede laasot sandal laachore hashshekof. afar, kede litten ben patztzim lachavero. kirot haevus, vekirot hammechitztza, enan mittammein bannegaim. yerushalayim vechutza laaretz, enan mittammein bannegaim:

Ketzad reiyyat habbayit. uva asher lo habbayit vehiggid lakkohen lemor kenega nira li babbayit (Vayikra 14). afillu talmid chacham veyodea shehu nega vadday, lo yigzor veyomar nega nira li babbayit, ella kenega nira li babbayit. vetzivva hakkohen ufinnu et habbayit (beterem yavo hakkohen lirot et hannega velo yitma kol asher babbayit veachar ken yavo hakkohen lirot et habbayit) (sham), vaafillu chavile etzim, vaafillu chavile kanim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer, esek hu lappinnuy. amar rabbi meir, vechi ma mittamme lo. im tomar, kele etzav uvegadav umattechotav, matbilan vehen tehorim. al me chasa hattora. al kele charso veal pakko veal tifyo. im kach chasa hattora al mamono habbazuy, kal vachomer al mamono hechaviv. im kach al mamono, kal vachomer al nefesh banav uvenotav. im kach al shel rasha, kal vachomer al shel tzaddik:
Mishnah Negaim 12:6-13:3:
Eno holech letoch beto umasgir, velo vetoch habbayit shehannega betocho umasgir, ella omed al petach habbayit shehannega betocho umasgir, shenneemar (Vayikra 14), veyatza hakkohen min habbayit el petach habbayit vehisgir et habbayit shivat yamim. uva vesof hashshavua veraa im pasa, vetzivva hakkohen vechilletzu et haavanim asher bahen hannaga vehishlichu ethen el michutz lair el makom tame. velakchu avanim acherot veheviu el tachat haavanim veafar acher yikkach vetach et habbayit (sham). eno notel avanim mitztzad ze umevi letzad ze, velo afar mitztzad ze umevi letzad ze, velo sid mikkol makom. eno mevi lo achat tachat shetayim velo shetayim tachat achat, ella mevi shetayim tachat shetayim, tachat shalosh, tachat arba. mikkan amru, oy larasha oy lishcheno, shenehen choltzin, shenehen kotzin, shenehen meviin et haavanim. aval hu levaddo mevi et heafar, shenneemar (sham), veafar acher yikkach vetach et habbayit, en chavero mittappel immo batticha:  
Ba vesof shavua veraa, im chazar, venatatz et habbayit et avanav veet etzav veet kol afar habbayit vehotzi el michutz lair el makom tame (sham). happisyon hassamuch, kol shehu. veharachok, kaggeris. vehachozer babbattim, kishne gerisin:  
Asara vattim hen, hakkehe varishon, vehaholech lo, kolfo vehu tahor. hakkehe vashsheni, vehaholech lo, kolfo vehu taun tzipporim. happose varishon, choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua. chazar, yinnatetz. lo chazar, taun tzipporim. amad barishon ufasa vashsheni, choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua. chazar, yinnatetz. lo chazar, taun tzipporim. amad baze uvaze, choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua. chazar, yinnatetz. lo chazar, taun tzipporim. im ad shello tiharo vatztzipporim nira vo nega, hare ze yinnatetz. veim mishshettiharo vatztzipporim nira vo nega, yerae battechilla: 
Haeven shebbazzavit, bizman shehu choletz, choletz et kullo. uvizman shehu notetz, notetz et shello umanniach et shel chavero. nimtza chomer bachalitza mibbannetitza. rabbi elazar omer, bayit habbanuy rosh ufittin, nira varosh, notel et kullo. nira vappittin, notel et shello umanniach et shel chavero: 
Bayit shennira vo nega, hayta aliyya al gabbav, noten et hakkorot laaliyya. nira vaaliyya, noten et hakkorot labbayit. lo hayta aliyya al gabbav, avanav veetzav vaafaro nittatzin immo. umatztzil al hammalbenim, veal serige hachallonot. rabbi yehuda omer, malben habbanuy al gabbav, nittatz immo. avanav veetzav vaafaro metammein bechazzayit, rabbi elazar chisma omer, bema shehen:
Mishnah Negaim 13:4-7:
Bayit hammusgar, metamme mittocho. vehammuchlat, mittocho umeachorav. ze vaze metammein bevia: 
Habbone min hammusgar betahor, vechazar nega labbayit, choletz et haavanim. chazar al haavanim, habbayit harishon yinnatetz, vehaavanim yeshammeshu et habbayit hashsheni besimanin: 
Bayit shehu mesech al gabbe vayit hamenugga, vechen ilan shehu mesech al gabbe vayit hamenugga, hannichnas lachitzon, tahor, divre rabbi elazar ben azarya. amar rabbi elazar, ma im even achat mimmennu metamma bevia, hu atzmo lo yetamme bevia: 
Hattame omed tachat hailan vehattahor over, tame. hattahor omed tachat hailan vehattame over, tahor. im amad, tame. vechen beeven hamenuggaat, tahor. veim hinnichah, hare ze tame:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Asur lo leadam laavor achore bet hakkeneset beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelin ella im ken haya nose massooy, o shehaya levet hakkeneset shene petachim bishne ruchot, sheharoe omer shemma yelech veyikkanes mippetach haacher. vechen im haya bair shene batte kenesiyyot yomar haroe shemma yelech levet hakkeneset haragil bo. veim yesh lo tefillin berosho muttar lo laavor veaf al pi sheen sham echad mikkol ellu shehattefillin mochichin alav shehu rodef achar mitzvot veeno mimmevattele tefilla:

Hammitpallel im hatztzibbur lo yaarich et tefillato yoter midday aval beno leven atzmo harshut beyado. veim ba lomar achar tefillato afillu keseder vidduy yom hakkippurim omer. vechen im ratza lehosif bechol beracha uveracha min haemtzaiyyot meen habberacha mosif:

Ketzad. haya lo chole mevakkesh alav rachamim bevirkat cholim kefi tzachut leshono. haya tzarich lefarnasa mosif techinna uvakkasha bevirkat hashshanim. veal derech ze bechol achat mehen. veim ratza lishol kol tzerachav beshomea tefilla shoel. aval lo yishal lo beshalosh rishonot velo beshalosh acharonot:

Asur lo leadam sheyyitom kelum o sheyyaase melacha meachar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar ad sheyyitpallel tefillat shacharit. vechen lo yashkim lefetach chavero lishl bishlomo kodem sheyyitpallel tefillat shacharit. velo yetze badderech kodem sheyyitpallel. aval toem veose melacha kodem sheyyitpallel musaf vekodem mincha. aval eno soed samuch lammincha:

Kevan shehiggia zeman mincha gedola lo yikkanes lammerchatz afillu lehazzia ad sheyyitpallel shemma yitallef veyibbatel min hattefilla. velo leechol afillu achilat aray shemma yimmashech baachila. velo ladun afillu bigmar din shemma yissater haddin veyimmashech veyibbatel min hattefilla. vechen lo yeshev lifne hassappar lisapper afillu tisporet hedyot ad sheyyitpallel shemma yishshaver hazzug. velo yikkanes levurseki samuch lammincha ad sheyyitpallel shemma yire hefsed bimlachto veyitassek bah veyitakkev min hattefilla. veim hitchil beachat meellu lo yafsik ella gomer veachar kach mitpallel tefillat mincha:

Meematay hatechalat tisporet mishsheyyanniach maaforet shel sapparin al birkav. umeematay hatechalat merchatz mishsheyyifshot habbeged hassamuch livsaro. umeematay hatechalat habburseki mishsheyyikshor beged ben ketefav kemo shehaummanin osin. umeematay hatechalat achila, livne eretz yisrael mishsheyyittol yadav velivne bavel mishsheyyattir chagoro. umeematay hatechalat haddin mishsheyyitattefu haddayyanim veyeshvu. veim hayu yoshvin mishsheyyatchilu baale dinin liton:

Af al pi shettefillat arvit reshut lo yavo adam mimmelachto veyomar ochal meat veishan kima veachar kach etpallel, shemma teenos oto shena venimtza yashen kol hallayla, ella mitpallel arvit veachar kach ochel veshote o yashen. umuttar lehistapper velikkanes lammerchatz samuch leshacharit mippene shello gazru ella samuch lammincha shehu davar hammatzuy sherov haam nichnasin sham bayyom. aval bashshachar davar sheeno matzuy lo gazru bo:

Mi shehaya osek betalmud tora vehiggia zeman hattefilla posek umitpallel. veim hayta torato ummanuto veeno ose melacha kelal vehaya osek battora bishat tefillato eno posek, shemmitzvat talmud tora gedola mimmitzvat tefilla. vechol haosek betzarche rabbim keosek bedivre tora:

En hammitpallel mafsik tefillato ella mippene sakkanat nefashot bilvad. vaafillu melech yisrael shoel bishlomo lo yeshivennu. aval posek hu lemelech oved kochavim shemma yahargennu. haya omed battefilla veraa melech ovde kochavim o annas ba kenegdo yekatztzer veim eno yachol yafsik. vechen im raa nechashim veakrabbim baim kenegdo im higgiu elav vehaya darkan beotan hammekomot shehen memitin posek uvoreach. veim lo haya darkan lehamit eno posek:
Nashim vaavadim uketannim chayyavim bitfilla. vechol ish sheppatur mikkeriat shema patur min hattefilla. vechol hamelavvin et hammet af al pi sheen lammitta tzorech bahen peturin min hattefilla:

Keshettikkennu chachamim divre tefillot ellu tikkenu berachot acherot levarech otan bechol yom, ellu hen. kesheyyikkanes adam lemittato lishon ballayla mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammappil chevle shena al enay vehammashkia shenat tardema vehammeir leishon bat ayin. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettatztzileni miyyetzer ra umippega ra veal yevahaluni chalomot raim velo hirhurim raim utehe mittati shelema lefanecha vetaamideni mimmenna lechayyim uleshalom vehaira enay pen ishan hammavet. baruch atta Adonai hammeir laolam kullo bichvodo:

Vekore parasha rishona mikkeriat shema veyashen. vaafillu ishto yeshena immo (kore pasuk rishon o pesuke rachamim veachar kach yishan). veim anasattu shena kore afillu pasuk rishon o pesuke rachamim veachar kach yishan:

Beshaa sheyyikatz besof shenato mevarech vehu al mittato kach. elohay neshama shennatatta bi tehora atta beratah veatta yetzartah veatta nefachtah bi veatta meshammerah bekirbi veatta atid littelah mimmenni veatta atid lehachazirah bi leatid lavo. kol zeman shehanneshama teluya bekirbi mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay ribbon kol hammaasim baruch atta Adonai hammachazir neshamot lifgarim metim:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 8:15-16:
Hattochen kigrogeret chayyav. vechol hashshochek tavlin vesammanin bemachteshet hare ze tochen vechayyav. hamechattech yarak talush hare ze toledet tochen. vechen hannoser etzim lehanot binsoret shellahen o hashshaf lashon shel mattechet chayyav mishsheyyashuf kol shehu. aval hamechattech etzim eno chayyav ad sheyyedakdek mehen kede levashshel kigrogeret mibbetza: 
Hamerakked kigrogeret chayyav. hallash kigrogeret chayyav hamegabbel et heafar hare ze toledet lash. vechamma shiuro kede laasot pi kor shel tzorfe zahav. veen gibbul beefer velo bechol haggas velo bemursan velo bechayyotze bahen. vehannoten zera shumshemin o zera pishtan vechayyotze bahen bemayim chayyav mishshum lash. mippene shehen mitarvin venitlin ze baze:
Niddah 20b:24-21a:2: Hashsharoni niddon kakkarmeli, chay velo mazug, chadash velo yashan.

Amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi: vechullan, en bodkin otan ella bechos teverya pashut. may tama? amar abbaye: shel kol haolam kullo machzik log — osin oto mimmane, shene luggin — osin oto mimmatayim. kos teverya pashut, afillu machazik shene luggin — osin oto mimmane, veayyeyde diklish — yedia beh tefe.

Sanhedrin 37a:2-8: Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi acha bar chanina: deamar kera "shorrech aggan hassahar al yechsar hammazeg vegomer".
"Shorrech" – zo sanhedrin. lamma nikra shemah "shorrech"? shehi yoshevet betibburo shel olam. "aggan" – shehi meginna al kol haolam kullo. "hassahar" – shehi doma lassahar.
"Al yechsar hammazeg" – sheim hutzerach echad mehem latzet, roin: im yesh esrim ushelosha, keneged sanhedri ketanna – yotze, veim lav – eno yotze.
"Bitnecha aremat chittim" – ma aremat chittim hakkol nehenin mimmenna, af sanhedrin hakkol nehenin mittaamehen. "suga bashshoshannim" – sheafillu kesuga shel shoshannim lo yifretzu bahen peratzot.

Vehayeynu daamar leh hahu mina lerav kahana: amritu nidda shere leyaychode bahade gavra. efshar esh binoret veenah mehavehevet? amar leh: hattora heida alenu "suga bashshoshannim", sheafillu kesuga bashshoshannim lo yifretzu bahen peratzot.
Resh lakish amar: mehacha, "kefelach harimmon rakkatech" – afillu rekanin shebbach melein mitzvot kerimmon. rabbi zera amar: mehacha, "vayyarach et reach begadav". al tikre "begadav" ella "bogdav".

Hanhu biryone dahavo beshivavuteh derabbi zera, dahava mekarev lehu ki hechi denehderu lehu bityuveta, vahavo kafdi rabbanan. ki nach nafsheh derabbi zera, amri: ad haiddana hava charicha kattin shakeh dahava bae alan rachame, hasheta man bae alan rachame? hareharu belibbayyhu vaavadu teshuva.
Zohar, Bamidbar 1: (Bamidbar 1:1) vaydabber Adonai el moshe bemidbar sinay beohel moed vegomer, ribbi abba patach, (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo vegomer, hay kera ittemar. ta chaze, beshaata devara kudesha berich hu leadam aved leh bediyyukena deillae vetattae, vahava kalil mikkolla, vahava nehoreh nahir, missayyfe alma ad sayyfe alma. vahavu dachalin kammeh kolla.

Veaf al gav deha ukemuha, it leistakkela beh behay kera, vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo betzelem elohim bara oto, kevan deamar betzalmo, may betzelem elohim bara oto. ella vadday teren dargin dichlilan dechar venukeba, chad lidchar, vechad lenukeba.

Uvegin kach du partzufin havo vday, vesefa dikra ochach, dichtiv zachar unekeva bara otam. vechalil hava mikkol sitrin (nusach acher muttarin sitrin) veaf al gav denukeba achidat besitroy. ha hi name kelila mitteren sitrin, lemehevi shelim becholla.

Vahava mistakkal bechachmeta, leella vetatta. kevan dessarach, itmaatu partzufin, vechachmmeta istalakat minneh, vela hava mistachal ella bemile degufeh. levatar olid benin meillae vetattae, vela ityashavu da veda bealma, ad deolid bar, uminneh ishtelim (sefer acher ashtil) alma, deikre shet, veha ukemuha.

Veim kol da, alma tattaa la ishtelim, vela hava shelim, vela ishtechach bekiyyumeh, ad deata avraham, veitkayyaym alma. aval la ishtelim, ad deavraham ishtechach beh bealma veachid beh bimina, keman deachid bimineh, leman denafil. ata yitzchak, veachid bideh dealma bismala, veitkayyaym yattir. kevan deata yaakov, achid beemtzaita begufa, veitkelil bitren sitrin, itkayyaym alma vela hava mitmotet.

Veim kol da la ashtil (sefer acher ishtelim) besharshoy, ad deolid teresar shevatin, veshivin nafshan, veashtil (sefer acher veishtelim) alma. veim kol da la ishtelim, ad dekabbilu yisrael orayyta betura desinay, veittekam mashkena. keden itkayyaymu almin veishtelimu, veitbesamu illain vetattain.

Kevan deorayyta umashkena ittokamu, baa kudesha berich hu lemifkad cheloy deorayyta, kama chayyaylin innun deorayyta, kama chayyaylin innun demashkena. ta chaze, kol milla devae leityayshsheva beducheteh, la mityayshsheva ad deidkar befuma, veitmene alah. uf hacha, baa kudesha berich hu lemifkad chayyaylin deorayyta, vechayyaylin demashkena, vechullehu havo kechad vela mitparshe da min da, kolla kegavvna dilella, deha orayyta umashkena la mitparshe da min da, veazlin kachada.

Uvegin kach, chayyaylehon alin bechushebana leishtemoda gabbayyhu, bar innun acharanin delet lon chushebana. uvegin kach ketiv, vaydabber Adonai el moshe bemidbar sinay beohel moed. i beohel moed, amay bemidbar sinay. ella chad leorayyta vechad lemashkena.

Vehay vehay, beechad lachodesh hashsheni bashshana hashshenit, vecholla chad, vehay ikre (Melachim 1 6:1) chodesh ziv remez lehahu yarcha veshatta denahir lesihara, deha keden almin kullehu ishtechachu bishlimu. letzetam meeretz mitzrayim, leishtemoda deha kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, bachodesh harishon hava.

Ribbi yitzchak patach, (Tehillim 115:12) Adonai zecharanu yevarech yevarech et bet vegomer. Adonai zecharanu yevarech, illen guverin. dahavo alin bechushebana bemadbera, vekudesha berich hu mevarech lon, veosif alayyhu bechol zimna.

Ta chaze, hay man deamar shevacha dechavreh, divnoy, o demamoneh, bae levarcha leh, uleodaa aleh birchan. menalan. mimmoshe. dichtiv, (Devarim 1:10) vehinnechem hayyom kechochve hashshamayim larov, levatar ma ketiv, Adonai elohe avotechem yosef alechem kachem elef peamim vegomer. teren birchan havo, chad Adonai elohe avotechem vegomer. ha chad. levatar vivarech etchem kaasher dibber lachem. leodaa alayyhu, birchan al birchan.

Vei ihu mane shevacha dechavreh, vela ode aleh birchan. hu nitpas bekadmita milleella. vei ihu mevarech leh, hu mitbarech milleella. uvircheta bae levarcha lah beena tava, vela beena bisha. uvecholla bae kudesha berich hu rechimuta delibba. uma man dimvarech lechavreh, bae kudesha berich hu diyyevarech leh beena tava, belibba tava. man dimvarech lekudesha berich hu, al achat kamma vechamma, devae ena tava, velibba tava, urechimuta delibba. begin kach (Devarim 6:Adonai) veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha vegomer.

Ta chaze, ha ukemuha let birchata dilella sharya, al milla deitmene. vei tema, yisrael ech itmenun. ella kufera natle minnayyhu, veha ukemuha, vechushebana la havi ad deyitkenish kol hahu kufera, vesalik lechushebna, uvekadmeta mevarchan lehu leyisrael, ulevatar menaan hahu kufera, ulevatar mehadderin umevarchin lon leyisrael. ishtechachu deyisrael mitbarchin bekadmita uvesofa, vela salik behu motana.

Motana amay salik beminyayna. ella begin devircheta la sharya beminyayna, kevan deistalak birchata, sitra achara share aloy, veyachil leatzeka. begin da beminyayna natlin kufera ufidyona, lesalleka aleh minnayyhu.

(Sefer acher mealeha motana) yevarech et bet yisrael, illen nashin, dela sallekin beminyayna. yevarech et bet aharon, deinnun mevarchin leamma, beena tava uvelibba tava, uvirchimuta delibba. et bet aharon, hachi name nashin (dilhon), deitbarchan bevirchata (sefer acher dilhon).
Yevarech yire Adonai. illen innun levae, vechullehu mitbarchin, begin dedachalin leh lekudesha berich hu. hakketanim im haggedolim, af al gav dela alin beminyayna.

Ta chaze la ishtechach minyayna behu beyisrael deitbarchan beh, kehay minyayna. dehay minyayna leitbarcha hava, uleashlema shelemuta dealmin hava, uvaatar devirkan nafkin itmenun, dichtiv beechad lachodesh hashsheni, deihu ziva devirkaan dealma, deminneh nafik ziva lealma. veal da ikre chodesh ziv, deziva decholla nafik minneh, veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 134:3) yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon, vecholla chad milla uchetiv (Tehillim 133:3) ki sham tzivva Adonai et habberacha vegomer.

Ribbi yehuda hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon, amar leh yisrael mean atar itbarchan. amar leh, vavy lealma, dela mashgichin vela mistakkelin bene nasha, bikara demalka illaa. ta chaze, beshaata deishtechachu yisrael zakkain kamme kudesha berich hu, vahavu almin (sefer acher immeh) shechichin bechad ilana illaa kaddisha, dimzona decholla beh, hava mitbarech meatar dechol birchan kenishin beh. uveh itneta veashtilu sharshoy.

Veyisrael letatta, havo mitbarchan (veashtilu sharshoy) meatar dechol innun birchan nafkin beh, vela mitakkeve lemeppak, hada hu dichtiv yevarechcha Adonai mitztziyyon, uchetiv (Tehillim 133:3) ketal chermon sheyyored al harere tziyyon ki sham tzivva Adonai et habberacha chayyim ad haolam. veda ihu nehiru dealma. dichtiv, (Tehillim 50:2) mitztziyyon mikkelal yofi elohim hofia. hofia: nahir. kema deat amer (Devarim 33:2) hofia mehar paran (sefer acher veda nehiru). vechad yenaher, yenaher lechullehu almin.

Vechad hay nehiru ittear, kolla hu bechavruta (sefer acher kolla hu bachavivuta), kolla hu birchimuta, kolla hu bishlimu, keden hu shelama decholla, shelama deella vetatta, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 122:7) yehi shalom bechelech shalva bearmenotayich.
Zohar, Bamidbar 3: (Bamidbar 2:2) ish al diglo veotot. illen arba mashshiryayn dichneset yisrael, deinnun teresar shevatin, teresar techumin, sechor sechor lah. kolla kegavvna dilella, ketiv (Tehillim 122:4) sheshsham alu shevatim shivte yah vegomer. sheshsham alu shevatim, illen 12 shevatin, 12 techumin diltatta.

Shivte yah, ha ukemuha begin deyah edut leyisrael vadday. uvegin da, harouveni, hashshimoni, yah bechol chad vechad. aval vadday hachi hu, deha ilana illaa kaddisha, behu achtam bechotamoy. veokmuha dichtiv, (yechezkel 1:10) udemut penehem pene adam ufene arye el hayyamin vegomer. diyyukena deadam itkelil bechullehu, veappin havo led sitrin dealma, umitparshan bediyyukenehon, vechulhon kelilan beh beadam.

Michael mimina, gavriel missemala, uriel lekadmayyhu, refael laachorayyhu, shechinta alayyhu. teren mikkan, uteren mikkan, vehi beemtzaita. kegavvna da beara diltatta, tere mikkan, utere mikkan, veyah benayyhu.

Kevan denatlin teren degalim, ma ketiv. venasa ohel moed machane haleviyyim vegomer. ulevatar, innun teren acharanin 4 mashshiryayn innun led sitre alma, veishtechachu teresar. uf hachi letatta kegavvna dilella.

Venasa barishona degel machane yehuda, lokovel mashshiryay deuriel. umachane diruven lokovel mashshiryay demichael. da laddarom, veda lemizrach. mizbeach hachi name deromit mizrachit. umachane dan latztzafon. machane efrayim yama. machane dan lokovel mashshiryay degavriel. machane efrayim lemaarav, lokovel mashshiryay dirfael mizbeach hachi name tzefonit maaravit. kolla achid da beda, ad desalleka kolla veitachad bishma kaddisha, deihu sheruta decholla. illaa decholla kaddisha decholla. kolla itkelil beh.
10 Mizrach hu sheruta dinhora, azil veshat veappik ledarom. vedarom nafik vetalyay besheruta demizrach. Adonai darom. minneh nafik darom bealma. veayil 10 besheruta demizrach, veappik leh.

Umin Adonai talyay darom vetzafon, vehahu (8) devenayyhu, 10 mizrach yah darom vetzafon talyayn beh. 6 beemtzaita. veda hu ben dechar. begin kach ihu ben tzafon ledarom. veal da tanenan, man deyahiv mittato ben tzafon ledarom, haveyayn leh banim zecharim. dehay ben dechar ihu ben tzafon ledarom. Adonai illaa bah talya tzafon vedarom, uven dechar benayyhu, beraza deyv. Adonai batraa maarav.
Veal da darom achid mizrach, deihu sheruta deshimsha vetalyay beh. veal da tanenan, missitra deabba achid vetalyay chesed illaa. missitra deima talyay gevura. kegavvna da achid kolla da beda.

Zavvyayn demadbecha hachi name istacharan, uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit. dedarom tukepeh bemizrach, deihu sheruta deshimsha, vetukepa deshimsha la sharyay ella besheruta. mizrachit tzefonit. kevan dedarom natil tukepeh demizrach, hu anhir latztzafon vetzafon itkelil bedarom, deha semala itkelil bimina.

Tzefonit maaravit, deha maarav deihi baAdonai batraa, natla mitztzafon. veal da tzafon azil lemaarav. maaravit deromit, hi azla (sefer acher laatachebakea) leitchabbera bedarom, kema dedarom talyay bemizrach, vetukepeh azil besheruta. hachi name maarav, azla (sefer acher laatachebakea) leitachada bedarom, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) vimino techabbekeni. yemina da hu darom. begin kach yanka mitteren sitrin, mitztzafon umiddarom. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. semolo da hu tzafon, vimino da hu darom.

Veraza da olifna, kudesha berich hu yahiv mittateh, ben tzafon ledarom. vaachidat lehay ben vday. veal da it lehu livne nasha lemehav mittatayyhu ben tzafon ledarom. vehachi olif li abba. deyahavin lehu benin dichrin. deha ihu itkevavn kelappe mehemnuta shelema illaa, bishlemuta decholla. legabbe kudesha berich hu deihu ben tzafon ledarom, ulegabbe keneset yisrael deanhirin (sefer acher deihi) ben tzafon ledarom. vadday yehevvan leh benin dichrin.

Uvecholla bae leachazaa ovada kegavvna dilella, uchemma deachze ovada letatta, hachi name ittear leella, veokmuha. shama ribbi pinchas, uneshakeh leribbi elazar, uvacha vechayich amar, zakkaa chulaki behay alma uvealma deate.
Zohar, Bamidbar 5: Amar ribbi elazar, ketiv (Tehillim 31:6) beyadcha afkid ruchi padita oti Adonai el emet. hay kera it leh leistakkela beh, chamittun man deafkid bida demalka midi. ella, vadday zakkaa hu bar nash, deazil beorchoy demalka kaddisha, vela chate kammeh ta chaze, kevan deal lelya, ilana demota shallit bealma, veilana dechayye istallak leella leella. vechevan deilana demota shallit bealma bilchodoy, kol bene alma taamin taama demota. may tama. begin dehahu ilana garim.

Uvar nash bae leakdema ulemifkad bideh nafsheh befikdona. kefikdona devar nash, deyahiv pikdona leachara, deaf al gav deihu itchayyayv legabbeh yattir mehahu pikdona, lav keday leitachada beh, hoil ufikdona itmesar legabbeh, vei yesarev beh, vadday nivduk avatreh, delav mizzara kaddisha hu, velav mibbene mehemnuta.

Kach hahu ilana, bene nasha akdimu veyahavin leh pikdona denafshayyhu, vechol nishmatin divne alma natil. vechullehu taamin taama demota, begin dehay ilana demota hu. uvegin dechol innun nafshata, af al gav dechullehu itchayyvu legabbeh, velav keday hu leatava pikdona legabbeh devar nash, ella kevan dechullehu itmesari leh befikdona, ativ kol pikdonin lemarehon.

Ta chaze, lav keday hu hay ilana demota leatava pikdona legabbeh devar nash. ella beshaata deilana dechayye ittear bealma. veematay ittear hahu ilana dechayye. beshaata desalik tzafra. ucheden, kevan dehay ittear bealma, kol bene alma chayyin, veshavik veahdar hahu ilana demota kol pikdonin deitpekadu legabbeh, veazil leh. may tama chayyin. begin dehahu ilana dechayye garim.

Vei tema, ha bene nasha saggiin innun demitarin belelya, beod deilana demota shallit. ella, vadday hahu ilana dechayye ka avid. may tama. begin dichtiv, (Tehillim 14:2) lirot hayesh maskil doresh et elohim. vela yehe leh pitchon pe levar nash, deyemma, ilmale shelitna benafshay belelya ishtaddalna beorayyta. amar ribbi yehuda, hay beyisrael vadday vehachi hu. aval beumot haolam dachamena kehay gavvna, may tama. amar leh vadday shappir hu deka amart.

Patach veamar, (Bamidbar 23:8) ma ekkov lo kabbo el uma ezom lo zaam Adonai. ta chaze, kegavvna deit leella, it letatta. leella it yemina veit semala. letatta yisrael veammin. yisrael itachadan limina, bikdushsha demalka kaddisha. ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot lismala, lesitra deruach misava. vechullehu letatta mikkullehu dargin dismala. vechullehu dargin achidan da beda, ad detalyayn min resha. uchegavvna deresha natil, behahu gavvna natil zanva, deihi tattaa. may tama. begin deachid beh. uvegin kach, ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, behahu setar misava dilhon, hachi itdebaru.

Bilam hu ishtammash bechullehu kitrin (nusach acher dargin) tattain. vehu hava chame behay tattaa deihu zanva, dela yachil leitdabbera ella beresha. begin kach amar, ma ekkov lo kabbo el, (deihu resha begin) dehahu resha illaa, la ishtechach bedina beinnun yomin.

Veaf al gav dehay el okimna, hay malchuta kaddisha natil shema kegavvna decholla, vehay tav vechesed dehay alma (sefer acher okimna baatar achara illaa vehu tav vechesed alma hay malchuta kaddisha natil shemma kegavvna deella) uvegin kach ikre el, ella deihu (leel 32) zoem bechol yom, deishtechach beh dina.

Veta chaze, el shadday (Shemot 253 amud alef) ha okimna deveh sippuka dealma veihu amar laolam day, deha hay el hu deizdevvavg bahadeh, uvegin kach ikre el shadday, el deshadday. veal da ma ekkov lo kabbo el. begin kach, kegavvna deittear resha, hachi name ittear tattaa.

Bacha ribbi elazar, patach veamar (Yirmeyahu 46:22) kolah kannachash yelech vegomer. hasheta (kehay gavvna) deyisrael begaluta, ihi vadday azla kenachash. chivya kad ihu (davar acher bedina) kafif resha leafra, salik zanva, shallit umache lechol innun deishtechachu kammeh. uf hachi hasheta begaluta, kehay gavvna, resha kafif leafra, vezanva shallit. man avid lezanva deyistelik leella veshalit umache, resha deitkafya letatta. veim kol da, man madbar leh lezanva, uman natil leh lematalnoy. hay resha. af al gav deihu kafif leafra, hu madbar lematalnoy, begin da kolah kannachash yelech.

Vehasheta shear ammin deinnun achidan biznava, sallekin leella, veshaltin umachyayn, veresha kafif leafra, kema deat amer (Amos Adonai:2) nafla lo tosif kum vegomer. veim kol da, hay resha madbar lezanva venatir (sefer acher venatil) leh, kema deat amer (Shir hashshirim 1:6) samuni notera et hakkeramim, illen ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, deinnun zanva. ata ribbi yehuda venashik yedoy, amar ilmale la shailna milla bealma, ella deshailna da veravavchna leh, day li. dehashta yedana ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, veshuletanuta dilhon hech mitdabbar. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dealayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 135:4) ki yaakov bachar lo yah vegomer.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, mahu lisgullato. amar leh, telat avahan illen ikrun segula, ben leella ben letatta, kegavvna da kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim, vecholla chad. veillen segullato shel kudesha berich hu leella, usegullato letatta, veda hu dichtiv (Shemot 19:5) vihyitem li segulla mikkol haammim.
Zohar, Bamidbar 8: Ribbi shimon patach (Tehillim 25:1-2) ledavid elecha Adonai nafshi essa elohay becha vatachti vegomer, may ka chama david lesaddera hay shevacha hachi. vechullehu shevache deinnun bealfa beta kullehu shelemin, vehay chasra dela it beh 6. vaamay siddura da leminpal al anpin.

Ella (ta chaze) raza illaa hu, ganiz ben chavrayyay. beshaata delelya al, (veshalta) ilana tattaa detalyay beh mota parish anpoy umechasseya lecholla. veal da itchashach. vechol bene alma taamin taama demota, veakdim bar nash veyahiv leh pikdona denafsheh, veafkedeh bideh befikdona. uvegin denatil lon befikdona, tav pikdona lemareh beshaata deate tzafra. kad ate tzafra vetav legabbeh pikdoneh, bae levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, deihu mehemana illaa.

Levatar dekam, al leve kenishta, mittar betotfe. itkesse bechisuy detzitzit. al umadke garmeh bekurebnin bekadmita. levatar kabbil aleh ol malchuta besiddura dishvache dedavid, deinnun siddura deol malchuta. uvesiddura dishvacha da, ashra aleh hahu ol. levatar siddura ditzlota dimyushav, utzelota dimumad, lekashshera lon kachada.

Ta chaze raza demilla af al gav ditzlota talyay bemillula vedibbura defuma, kolla talyay beikara deovada bekadmita, ulevatar bedibbura uvemillula defuma. man ovada, ella hahu ovada deavid bar nash bekadmita, kegavvna ditzlota hu, vela yitzle bar nash tzelota, ad deyitchaze ovada bekadmita kegavvna ditzlota. (Shemot 201 amud bet)

Ovada dekadmeta (sefer acher bekadmita ovada) beshaata devar nash kaim, bae ledakkea garmeh bekadmita. ulevatar yekabbel aleh hay ol, lefarsa al resheh perisu demitzva. levatar yitkeshar kishshura deyichuda deinnun tefillin, (mahu tefillin) tefilla shel rosh, veshel yad. uleatkena lon bekishshura chada bismala, veal libba, kema deokimna (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vegomer. uchetiv (Shir hashshirim 8:6) simeni chachotam al libbecha kachotam al zeroecha. veha okimna. veda hu ovada bekadmita.

Levatar beshaata debar nash al leve kenishta, yidke garmeh bekadmita, bekarbenin, bemillula defuma. levatar yekabbel aleh hay ol malchut, lefarsa al resheh (perishu demitzva) beshivche dedavid malka. kegavvna deovada defaris al resheh perisu demitzva. ulevatar tzelota dimyushav, lokovel tefilla shel yad. levatar tzelota dimumad, dehi lokovel tefilla deresha. veda kegavvna deda. ovada kegavvna dedibbura. vadday beovada umillula talyay tzelota.

Vei pagim ovada, millula la ashkach atar desharya beh, velav ihu tzelota, veitpegim hahu bar nash leella vetatta. (velo od ella) devaenan leachazaa ovada, ulemallela millula aleh, veda hu tzelota shelim. vavy leh levar nash defagim tzeloteh, pulechana demareh. aleh ketiv, (Yeshayahu 1:15) ki tavou leraot panay vegomer. gam ki tarbu tefilla enenni shomea, deha beovada uvemillula talya milleta.

Ta chaze, kevan devar nash avid tzelota kegavvna da, beovada uvemillula, vekashir kishshura deyichuda, ishtechach deal yedeh mitbarchan illain vetattain. keden bae leh levar nash leachazaa garmeh, batar desiyyem tzelota daamida, keillu itpetar min alma, deha itperash min ilana dechayye, vechanish ragloy legabbe hahu ilana demota, deahadar leh pikdoneh. kema deat amer (Bereshit 49:33) vayyeesof raglav el hammitta. deha ode chetoy, vetzalle alayyhu. hasheta bae leitkannesha legabbe hahu ilana demota, uleminpal, velema legabbeh elecha Adonai nafshi essa. bekadmita, yahivna lach befikdona, hasheta dekashirna yichuda, veavedna ovada umillula kedka yeot, veodena al chataay, ha nafshi masirna lach vadday.

Veyecheze bar nash garmeh keillu patir min alma, denafsheh masir lehay atar demota, begin kach la it beh vav, devav ilana dechayye hu, vehay ilana demota hu. veha ka mashma lan, deraza demilla, (may ka mashma lan raza demilla) deit chovin dela mitkapperan, ad deitpetar bar nash mealma, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 22:14) im yechuppar heavon hazze lachem ad temutun, vehay yahiv garmeh vadday lemota, umasir nafsheh lehay atar. lav befikdona kema belelya, ella keman deitpetar min alma vadday.

Vetikkuna da bae bechavvavna delibba ucheden kudesha berich hu merachem aloy, umechapper leh lechoveh. zakkaa hu bar nash deyada lemippete leh, ulemiflach lemareh, biruta uvechavvavna delibba. vavy leh leman deate lemifte lemareh, belibba rechika, vela biruta. kema deat amer (Tehillim 78:36-37) vayfattuhu befihem uvilshonam yechazzevu lo velibbam lo nachon immo. hu omer (Tehillim 25:1) elecha Adonai nafshi essa, velav kol milloy ella belibba rechika, ha garam aleh leistalleka mealma, ad la matun yomoy, bezimna deha ilana ittear bealma lemebad dina.

Veal da bae bar nash leadbeka nafsheh ureuteh bemareh, vela yete legabbeh biruta kediva, begin dichtiv, (Tehillim 101:7) dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay. may lo yikkon. ella beshaata dehu atkin garmeh lehay, velibbeh rechika mikudesha berich hu, kala nafik veamar, lo yikkon leneged enay. (amay) hay bae leatkena garmeh, lo yikkon, la baena deyittakkan. kol shekken i ate leyachada shema kaddisha, vela meyached leh kedka yeot.

Zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayya bealma den uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 66:18) uvau verau et chevodi vegomer. uchetiv, (Tehillim 140:14) ach tzaddikim yodu lishmecha vegomer. ata ribbi elazar venashik yedoy. amar, ilmale la atena lealma ella lemishma millin illen dayay. amar ribbi yehuda, zakkaa chulakana, vezakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, deinnun mitdabbekin bekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim vegomer. (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim vegomer. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen
Zohar, Nasso 1: (Bamidbar 4:21-22) vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor, naso et rosh bene gershon vegomer. ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 32:2) ashre adam lo yachashov Adonai lo avon veen berucho remiyya. hay kera, lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh. veit leistakkela beh, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, beshaata ditzlota demincha dina sharya bealma, veyitzchak tikken tzelota demincha, ugevura illaa shalta bealma, ad deate veal lelya, begin lekabbela leh (lelelya), umizzimna deshari tzelota demincha, itperash semala lekabbela (leh) veittear lelya.
Batar deittear kol innun neture pitchin dilvar, kullehu mitarin bealma veitpashatu. vechol bene alma taamin taama demota.

Veha ittemar. befalgut lelya mammash, ittear semala kemillekaddemin, uvarda kaddisha salleka rechin, vehi meshabbachat vaarimat kala, ucheden salleka vesharya resha leella bismala, usemala mekabbel lah.

Keden karoza kare bealma, deha iddan hu leitteara leshabbecha leh lemalka. ucheden tushebchan mitarin, veitbassemuta decholla ishtechach. zakkaa chulakeh man deittear lezavvevga ziuuga da. kad ate tzafra, vimina ittear umechabbeka lah, keden ziuuga decholla ishtechach kachada. (sefer acher lemalka, kad ate tzafra vimina ittear vamechabek la keden ziuuga decholla ishtechach kachada ucheden taveshabechaten mitarin veitbassemuta decholla ishtechach zakkaa chulakeh man deittear lezavvevga ziuuga da)

Ta chaze, beshaata divne nasha demichin, vetaamin taama demota, venishmeta salleka leella, kayyeyma baatar dekayyeyma, veitbechinat al ovadaha deavdat kol yoma, vechatvin lehu al pitka. may tama. begin denishmeta salleka leella, veashidat al ovadoy debar nash, veal kol milla umilla denafik mippumeh.

Vechad hahi milla deappik bar nash mippumeh ihi kedka yaut, milla kaddisha deorayyta utzelota. hahi milla salleka, uvaka rekiin, vekayyeyma beatar dekayyeyma, ad deal lelya, venishmeta salleka veachid lehahi milla, veail lah kamme malka.

Vechad hahi milla lav ihi kedka yaut, veihi milla mimmilin bishin, millishana bisha, hahi milla salleka laatar desalleka, ucheden itreshim hahi milla, vehahu chova aleh debar nash, hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:Adonai) mishshochevet chekecha shemor pitche picha. uvegin kach (Tehillim 32:2) ashre adam lo yachashov Adonai lo avon. ematay. kesheen berucho remiyya.
Zohar, Terumah 41: Amar rabbi yehuda, dina deonshe degehinnam, ha olifna, deihu lemedan tamman lechayyayvayya, al ma itdanu benura degehinnam. ella gehinnam ihu nur dalik yemame velele, kegavvna dechayyayvayya mitchamman benura deyetzer hara, lemebar al pitgame orayyta. bechol chimuma vechimuma deinnun mitchammeman beyetzer hara, hachi ittokad nura degehinnam.

Zimna chada la ishtechach yetzer hara bealma, deailu leh go gushepanka defarzela, benukeba dithoma rabba. vechol hahu zimna, kava nura degehinnam, vela ittokad kelal. ahdar yetzer hara leatreh, sharu chayyayve alma leitchamma beh, shaari nura degehinnam leittokda, deha gehinnam la ittokad ella bechamimu detukepa deyetzer hara dechayyayvayya. uvehahu chamimu, nura degehinnam ittokad yemame velele, vela shachich.

Shiva pitchin innun laggehinnam, veshiva madorin innun tamman. shiva zine chayyayvin innun: ra. beliyyaal. chote. rasha. mashchit. letz. yahir. vechullehu lokovlayyhu it madorin laggehinnam, kol chad vechad kadka chazi leh. uchefum hahu darga dechata beh hahu chayyayva, hachi yahavin leh madora begehinnam.
Uvechol madora umadora, it malach memana al hahu atar, techot yeda deduma. vechamma elef veribbo immeh, dedayynin lon lechayyayvayya, kol chad vechad kema deitchaze leh behahu madora deihu tamman.

(Sefer acher eshsha degehinnam dilella, mate lehay gehinnam diltatta) eshsha degehinnam letatta, mate miggo eshsha degehinnam dilella, umate lehay gehinnam diltatta, veittokad, behahu ittearu dechamimu dechayyayvayya, deka mechamme garmayyhu go yetzer hara, vechol innun madorin delikin tamman.

Atar it begehinnam, vedargin tamman deikrun (252 amud alef, 265 2, pinchas 258 amud alef) tzoa rotachat, vetamman ihu zuhama denishmatin, innun demitlachlechan mikkol zuhama dehay alma. umitllabbenan vesallekin, veishtearat hahu zuhama tamman, veinnun dargin bishin deitkerun tzoa rotachat, itmanan al hahu zuhama. venora degehinnam shalta, behahu zuhama deishtearat.

Veit chayyayvin, innun demitlachlechan bechovayyhu tadir, vela itlabbenan minnayyhu, umitu belo teshuva, vechatu vehechotiu acharanin, vahavu keshe kedal tadir, vela itbaru kame marihon behay alma. illen (vayyeshev 190 amud bet) itdanu tamman behahu zuhama, uvehahi tzoa rotachat, dela nafkin mittamman lealmin. innun dimchabbelin archayyhu al ara, vela chashshu likara demarehon behay alma, kol innun itdanu tamman ledare darin, vela nafke mittamman.

Beshabbate uveyarche uvizmanne uvechagge, behahu atar nura ishtechach, vela itdanu, aval la nafke mittamman, kishar chayyayvin deit lehu nayycha. kol innun dimchallele shabbatot uzemane, vela chayyshe likara demarehon kelal, begin lemetar lon, ella mechallele befarhesya, kema deinnun la natre shabbate uzemani behay alma, hachi name la natrin leh behahu alma, velet lon nayycha.

Amar ribbi yosi, la tema hachi, ella natre shabbate uzemani tamman begehinnam beal karchayyhu. amar rabbi yehuda, illen innun ovde kochavim umazzalot, dela itpekadu, dela natre shabbat behay alma, natre leh tamman baal karchayyhu.

Bechol maale shabbeta kad yoma itkaddash, charozin azlin bechol innun madorin degehinnam: seliku dina dechayyayvayya, deha malka kaddisha atya, veyoma itkaddash, veihu aggin al kolla. umiyyad dinin istalaku, vechayyayvayya it lon nayycha. (vechol inun mechallele shabbatot uzemani befarhesya dinin sallekin minnayyhu (nusach acher vaafillu ovde kochavim umazzalot dela itpekadu lemitar shavti uzemani tamman natrin baal karcham)) aval nura degehinnam la ishtekach, mealayyhu dela natre shabbat lealmin. vechol chayyayve gehinnam shaale alayyhu, may shena illen delet lon nayycha, mikkol chayyayvin dehacha. innun marehon dedina tayyvin lon, illen innun chayyayvin dekafru beh bekudesha berich hu, veavru al orayyta kulla, begin dela natru shabbat tamman, begin kach let lehu nayychin lealmin.

Veinnun chayyayvin kullehon, nafkin midduchetayyhu, veityeyhiv lon reshu lemehach lemecheme behu. umalach chad di shemeh santiriel, azil veappik lehahu gufa dilhon, veayil leh laggehinnam, leenehon dechayyayvayya, vechamman leh desalleka tolain, venishmeta let lah nayycha benura degehinnam.

Vechol innun chayyayvayya detamman, sacharin lehahu gufa, umachrize aleh, da ihu pelanya chayyayva, dela chayish likara demareh, kafar beh bekudesha berich hu, vechafar bechol orayyta kulla, vavy leh, tav dela yitbere, vela yete ledina da, ulekissufa da, hada hu (212 amud alef) dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:24) veyyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi ki tolatam lo tamut veishsham lo tichbe vehayu deraon lechol basar. ki tolatam lo tamut, min gufa. veishsham lo tichbe, min nishmeta. vehayu deraon lechol basar, vehayu day raon, ad dechol chayayvin degehinnam detamman, yiyimrun, day reiya da.
Ribbi yosi amar, vadday hachi hu, begin deshabbat ihu lokovel orayyta kulla, veorayyta ihi esh, begin deavru al esh deorayyta, ha esh degehinnam dalik, dela shachich mealayyhu lealmin.

Amar rabbi yehuda, levatar kad nafik shabbeta, ate hahu malach, umehader hahu gufa lekivreh, veittedanu tarvavyyhu, da lesitreh veda lesitreh. vechol da, beod degufa kayyayma al bureyeh, deha kevan degufa itakkol, let leh legufa kol illen dinin, vekudesha berich hu (Tehillim 78:38) lo yair kol chamato ketiv beh.

Kol chayyayvin dealma, beod degufa shelim bechol shayyfoy go kivra, itdanu gufa verucha, kol chad dina kadka chazi leh. kevan degufa itakkol, dina derucha ishtechach. man deitzterich lenafka, nafik. uman deitzterich lemeheve alayyhu nayycha, it lon nayycha. uman deitzterich lemeheve kitma veafra techot ragle detzaddikayyay. kol chad vechad, kadka chazi leh, itavid leh.

Veal da, kama tav lon, ben letztzadike, ben lechayyayve, lemehve gufa dilhon davik beara, uleitakkela go afra lizman kariv, vela lemeheve bekiyyuma kol hahu zimna saggi, begin leitdena gufa venafsha verucha tadir. deha let lach kol tzaddik vetzaddik bealma, delet leh dina dekivra. begin dehahu malach dimmana al kivre, kaim al gufa, vedan leh bechol yoma veyoma. im latzaddikim kach, lechayayvim al achat kamma vechamma.
Uvezimna degufa itakkol veitbele beafra, ha dina ishtechach mikkolla, bar meinnun chaside kayaymin dealma, deinnun itchazun lesalleka nishmathon lehahu atar illaa deitchaze lon, uzeirin innun bealma.

Kol innun metin dealma, kullehu metin al yede demalacha mechabbela, bar innun demetin beara kaddisha, (vechulehu metin al yede demalacha mechabbela deihu malach hammavet, vechol inun metin di beara kaddisha) la metin al yedoy, ella al yede demalacha derachame deshallit beara.

Amar rabbi yitzchak, i hachi, may shevacha ihu lemoshe uleaharon umiryam, dichtiv behu (Bamidbar log Devarim la) al pi Adonai, deillen la mitu al yede dehahu malach mechabbela, veat amart, dechule alma innun demitu beara deyisrael, la metin al yedoy deda.

Amar leh, hachi hu vadday, ushevacha demoshe aharon umiryam, hava yattir mikkol bene alma, deinnun mitu levar meara kaddisha, demoshe aharon umiryam levar meara kaddisha mitu, vechullehu mitu al yede dehahu mechabbela, bar innun moshe veaharon umiryam, dela mitu ella al yede dekudesha berich hu. aval innun demetin beara kaddisha, la metin al yede dehahu mechabbela, deha ara kaddisha la kayyeyma birshu achara, ella birshu dekudesha berich hu bilchodoy.

Veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) yichyu metecha nevelati yekumun hakitzu verannenu shochne afar vegomer. yichyu metecha, illen demetin beara kaddisha, deinnun metin dileh, vela meachara, dela shalta tamman sitra achara kelal, veal da ketiv metecha. nevelati yekumun, innun demitu beara nucheraa achara, al yede dehahu mechabbela.

Veal da ikrun nevela, ma nevela metammea bemassa, uf innun demetin levar meara kaddisha, metamin bemassa. (nusach acher bemagga) veal da innun nevela. kol shechita deifsil, ikre nevela, begin shechita ha ihi missitra achara, umiyyad deifsil sharya alah sitra achara. uvegin deihi dileh, vesharya alah ikre nevela. veraza da (sefer acher kishmo ken hu) naval hu, (Shmuel 1 25:25) venaval shemo unevala immo.

Veal da bechol atar deihu sharya, ikre nevela. menuval da la sharya, ella beatar pesilu, veal da shechita deafsil, ha dileh hu, veikre al shemeh. uvegin kach, metin deinnun levar meara kaddisha, techot reshu achara, vesharya alayyhu sitra achara, ikrun nevela.

Hakitzu verannenu shochne afar, shochne, dayyrin demichin, vela metin. uman innun. demichin dechevron, deinnun la metin, ella demichin. veal da ketiv behu gevia, keman degavav, veit beh kiuma leanara. uf hachi innun 4 zuge dechevron, demichin innun vela metin, vechullehu kayymu bekiumayyhu beinnun gufin dilhon, veyade sitrin genizin, yattir mishshear bene nasha. genizin havo tamman go pitcha degan eden innun gufin dilhon, veillen innun shochne afar. veal da kol innun denafku nishmatayyhu beara kaddisha, la nafik al yede dehahu mechabbela, vela shalta tamman, ella al yede demalacha derachame, deara kaddisha kayyeyma beadveh.

rashi: Ki mitz chalav. ki kaasher tetze chema al yede mitz chalav vedam al yede mitz hachotem yoter midday, ken yetze riv al yede mitz appayim shel kaas. mitz sechita 541 belaaz, kemo "vayyimetz tal vegomer" (Shoftim 6:38). verabbotenu pershu (berachot 63:): im nibbalta atzmecha al divre tora, lidrosh velishol sefekotecha lerabbecha, vaafillu nireta lo keshote belo lev, sofcha shettehe menussa; veim zammota – im samta zemam al picha vechasamta oto velo shaalta lo hakkol, sofcha kesheyyishalcha devar halacha, titten yad lappe vetealem, shello teda laanot kelum bo. kaasher mitz chalav yotzi chema, ken mitz appayim. sherabbecha koes becha shello havinota maher, veatta mitnabbel aleha – sof yotzi mippicha achar zeman halachot rabbot vehoraot:
targum: Deman demaytza chalava nafka chemata umin kivusha derugeza nippuk dema umin charyana deappe nippuk dina:

ohc: Vezot asu vegomer. perush hammaase hu shello yihyu bene kehat birshut atzman laset kecheftzam, sheaz letzad chibbat avodat hakkodesh hakkol ratzim laavod venimtzeu shoggim baddavar, ella yasimu otam aharon uvanav ish ish vegomer uvaze kol echad makkir mekomo, vehu amro vesamu otam ish vegomer, vehu amro velo yavou lirot perush kede shello yavou lide reiyya kevalla et hakkodesh, uferush vesamu hu shello yoil behakkarat kol echad mekomo levad ella lo yikkanes lasim yado laset ad sheyyomar lo aharon uvanav: peloni sim yadcha bemakom peloni lissa, vechen al ze hadderech, vehu amro vesamu otam, velaze timtza bemitzvat bene gershon hagam sheamar hakkatuv "al pi aharon uvanav tihye kol avodat" vegomer lo amar "vesamu" vegomer (Bamidbar 4:27).
Vechayu velo yamutu. perush, ki behitassekam baaron shebbo hattora shehu mekor hachayyim yaarichu yamim, velachashash hahezzek sheyyachol lihyot mehannegia veharut bo amar velo yamutu:
Chassalat parashat Bamidbar

rashi: Et yizreel. et bene haggola shennizreu venikbetzu:
targum: Veara tarbe ibbura vechamra umishcha veinun yesappekun legalvat ami:

rashi: Ahuvat rea. chaviva al balah vaahuva lo, vehi menaefet tachtav, keahavat hakkadosh baruch hu et yisrael vehem zonim tachtav el elohim acherim (Devarim 31:16):
Ashishe anavim. peresh menachem: gevie yayin, ohavim lehishtakker beyenam veenam oskim battora. vechen matzinu shemmochicham bemakom acher al kach: "hashshotim bemizreke yayin" (Amos 6:6):
targum: Vaamar Adonai li od ezel itnabbe nevua al bet yisrael deinun daman leitteta dirchima al baalah umezanya alohi vechol keden rachem lah vela tzave lemifterah ken rechimat Adonai al bene yisrael veinun mitpenan batar taavat ammaya beram im yetuvun yishtevek lehon vihon daman ligvar deishtele vaamar mila bechavreh:

ohc: Naso et rosh bene kehat. lefi ma sheheelenu befarashat ki tissa, ki al yede netinat hakkofer hu nesiat rosh lahem, velaze amar hakkatuv bemisparam "ki tissa" (Shemot 30:12), ma sheen ken haleviyyim shello natnu kofer bemisparam, amar "pekod et bene levi", im ken lamma shinna hakkatuv et leshono balviyyim atzman vechazar lomar naso velo pekod?

Venire ki letzad shennatan Adonai lahem avoda penimit laset aron veshulchan, laze yiches lahem leshon nesiut rosh beerech gershon umerari sheyyihyu hem meullim mehem, vahagam sheggershon hu bechor levi, kehat bachar lo yah ki mimmennu yatza or laolam, moshe veaharon, veshurat haddin sheanaf ze yissa aron hattora asher sam moshe sheyyatza mikkehat.
Vedikdek lomar mittoch bene levi, mittaam sheamarnu, letzad shehu emtzai ben gershon uven merari, veyityaches elav toch.

rashi: Metive tzaad. holchim umatzlichim bigvuratam:
targum: Telata inun deshappiran halichathon vearbea deshappir mehalechin:

ohc: Tifkedu otam. chazar lomar ken velo hispik bema shekkadam lomar seu et rosh vegomer, lehaircha bechavvanat amro seu sheyyechavven al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni Bamidbar 1) sheamru shennitkanneu ummot haolam beyisrael ma rau lehitkarev vechulei, amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: haviu li sefer ikonin shellachem, venimtza kol echad eno yodea meezo mishpacha hu, ad kan. hare ki yakpid Adonai al hayyichus veyushpal kol hechaser sefer ikonin, laze keshebba Adonai letzauot lifkod bene yisrael kadam lomar seu leshon nesiut verommut, limtzo lechol echad sefer ikonin, ma sheen ken beummot haolam. veachar kach beer ma hi hammaala, mibben esrim shana vegomer tifkedu otam, umeatta tzericha legufah.

rashi: Likkehat em. likmatim hannikbatzim venikhin bifne immo, leshon "yikkehat ammim" (Bereshit 49:10) – kevutzat ammim. vehayyod yesod, kemo "yifat" (Yechezkel 28:7), "veyaalat chen" (Mishlei 5:19):

Yikkeruha. leshon "tenakker" (Bamidbar 16:14), "nikrat hatztzur" (Shemot 33:22), 506 belaaz. yavo haorev shehu achzari al banav, veyikkeruha, velo yochlenna velo yehane bah, veyavo nesher shehu rachamani al banav veyochluha veyehane bah. haorev achzari hu, kemo shenneemar "livne orev asher yikrau" (tehillim 147:9), vehannesher rachamani, shenneemar "yissaehu al evrato" (Devarim 32:11; raa tanchuma ekev 2):
targum: Ena dimtzarya leav veshayta keshishuta deima nechtzuneh ureve denachala veyisamun yateh bene nishra:

rashi: Et kerameha. tirgem yonatan leshon parnasim umanhigim, vechen "lo yifne derech keramim" (Iyov 24:18), vechen "karmi shelli lo natarti" (Shir HaShirim 1:6). davar acher: veholachtiha hammidbar – lemidbar sichon veog, uvesignon ze nitnabbe (Yechezkel 20:35) shenneemar: "veheveti etchem el midbar haammim venishpatti ittechem sham kaasher nishpatti et avotechem veheveti etchem bemasoret habberit uvaroti mikkem hammordim vegomer" (Pesikta derav kahana 5,8; Rut Rabba 5,6), vehakkesherim akayyem, vezehu et kerameha:
Veet emek achor omek hatztzarot shehen achurim sham etten lah lefetach tikva, shemmittoch otan tzarot titten lev lashuv elay:
Veanta shamma. leshon 'dira, kemo "meon arayot" (Nachum 2:12):
Kime neureha. sheyyashva bemitzrayim yamim rabbim:
Ucheyom alotah vegomer: shetztzaaka elay mimmitzrayim mittoch shibud ugealtiha, ken gam atta:
