targum: Vaamane lah yat parnasaha mittaman veyat meshar achor letachamude nefash veyitnehon taman lememri keyome kodam veaf ana abed lehon nisin ugevuran keyom misakhon meara demitzrayim:

rashi: Vahashimmoti. leshon 'shemama:
Etna. kemo 'etnan:
Vesamtim leyaar. shehachayyot mehallechot sham veochlot happerot:
targum: Veatzde feri gufenah vetenah dahavat amra yekar inun li dihavu li ammaya rachame vaashavinun lechuresha vetachlinun chayat bara:

ohc: Bemidbar sinay vegomer. razal darshu (bemidbar Rabba 1:1) havanot yekarot befasuk ze, venishar lehair lamma lo hishva Adonai middotav yitbarach beshiur haddevarim, ki keshehizkir hodaat hammakom hikdim machberet hakkelalut shehu midbar sinay veachar kach hizkir perat hammakom veamar beohel moed, ucheshehizkir hodaat hazzeman hikdim zichron perat hazzeman veamar beechad lachodesh hashsheni veachar kach hizkir machberet kelalut hazzeman veamar bashshana hashshenit.

Venire ki hakkatuv adrabba hiskil ledabber beshiur shave, vehu al derech amram (Shemot Rabba 45:6) "hinne makom itti" – shemmekomo shel hakkadosh baruch hu hu tafel lo, uleerech ze yihye tafel kol hammakom legabbe hammakom asher chone sham haelohim, umeatta machberet hakkelalut hu ohel moed vehammidbar hu perat tafel lo, ulehaircha hakkatuv bechavvana zo sidder samuch laze maamar beechad lachodesh vegomer bashshana hashshenit, im ken maamar beohel moed hu machberet hakkelalut velaze nisdar baacharona keseder shana hashshenit shennisdar achar maamar beechad lachodesh. veteda kamma hu muflag makom asher Adonai sham mimma shemmatzinu shebbishte ammot shebben badde haaron amdu revuchim shishshim ribbo shel yisrael (Bereshit Rabba 4,4; 5,6), hare shehagam shehu laayin muat hu merubbe letzad hashshochen bo baruch hu.
Vehaleviyyim lo hatpakdu vegomer. perashti lemala (pasuk 2) kavvanato bemaamar ze.

rashi: Dor ma ramu enav. ze gassut haruach:
targum: Dara deramu aynoy ugevinoy menatlin:

rashi: Veriddefa. mimmishkelot lashon kaved hu ze, kemo (Mishlei 12:11) "umeraddef rekim", 696 belaaz, kelomar tachazor acharehem velo tassigem:
Et meahaveha mitzrayim veashshur, velo tucheli levakkesh mehem ezra:
Uvikshatam. uviksha otam:
targum: Vetirdaf shelam im ammaya rachamaha vela tidbak yathon vetibbee said vela tishkach vetemar ehach veetuv lefulechan ribboni kadmaa are tav li kad haveti palcha kodamohi michan la eflach letaavata:

ohc: Veet kol haeda vegomer beechad lachodesh. yodia hakkatuv ki bayyom atzmo nikhalu hayyehudim al haddavar, vehaddavar yaggid shekkol echad haya lo yichuso etzlo belo torach haraya vehaeduyyot. gam shebbo vayyom hukkeru hayyichusin shel kullan, vehu amro vayyityaldu samuch lemaamar "beechad lachodesh" vegomer:

Vayyityaldu vegomer. katav Rashi zichrono livracha: heviu sefer yichusehen veede chezkat ledatan kol echad veechad lehityaches al hashshevet. vehissig ramban ki lo hayu tzerichin lechol ze, ad kan. veulay ki hutzrechu lechezkat leda lemechush mamzer shemmakkir aviv, vehakkarat mamzeruto tihye mehalleda, vetzarich lehavi chezkat leda, perush shennolad bechashrut, vezulat ze yuchal hammamzer lomar sefer yochasin ad yaakov asher hodiattu immo.

Vehayu li haleviyyim ani Adonai. hakkavvana bemaamar ani Adonai, lomar shehagam sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni 364) atida avoda shettachzor labbechorot, lo yerdu haleviyyim mihyot laAdonai, vehu amro vehayu li ani Adonai keshem sheshshemi leolam vaed kemo chen yihyu li haleviyyim:

rashi: Nifleu mimmenni. nichsu mishshechalfu meenay, veeni yodea lehechan halchu, shemmemaharin lehissater min haayin:
targum: Telat inun dignizan mini vearba dela yedaet inun:

rashi: Veotzer racham. tashmish:
targum: Sheyol veachadat rachame veara la sava maya venura la amra mista:

rashi: Uzeratiha li kezorea sea lehachenis kamma korin, ken yitvassefu alehen beeretz yisrael kamma gerim (fesachim paz,2):
targum: Vaakayminchon kodamay beara bet shechinti vaarachem alehon dela rechimin beovadehon veemar lidhaveti amar lehon la ami beram ami attun vehu yemar elahay:

rashi: Zarzir matnayim o tayish. lo yadati mahu, ulefi hammashma hi chayya teshusha matnayim:

Umelech alkum. lo yadati ma hu lefi peshuto. umidrash aggada potrin chamesh parashiyyot ellu shel arba devarim keneged arba malchuyyot, lefi shennitammetza memshaltan al yisrael beavon sheavru al chamishsha chumeshe tora, hizkiram chamishsha peamim:

(16) Sheol veotzer racham. sheol malchut bavel, shenneemar binvuchadnetztzar "hirchiv kashsheol nafsho" (Chavakuk 2:5). veotzer racham zo hi maday shebbimehem atzru rachamim miyyisrael, shenneemar "lehashemid laharog uleabbed" (Ester 3:13):
Eretz lo sava mayim. zo yavan, shello sava milligzor gezerot raot al yisrael:
Veesh lo amra hon. neged esav, sheasa bechema boeret al yisrael, sheamru lehashemid taf venashim beyom echad (Ester 3:13). vechen:
(19) Derech hannesher. zo bavel, "hannesher haggadol… erech haever" (Yechezkel 17:3):
Nachash. zo maday (Daniel 8:20):
Derech oniyya velev yam. zo yavan, shehi kalla bigzeroteha (Mishlei 30:19):
Derech gever bealma. zo paras sheamra: "leolam ehye geveret" (Yeshayahu 47:7):
(20) Ken derech ishsha menaafet. zo haraa garma lahem lichneset yisrael shennaafa baavodat gillulim, ucheday hu happureaniyyot lavo lah:
Veamra lo faalti aven. kedaamar "hinni nishpat otach al amrech lo chatati" (yirmeya 2:35). [74 kan loshon Rashi 445]:
(21) Ragza eretz. eretz yisrael:
(22) Tachat eved. ze nevuchadnetztzar shehaya eved limrodach baladan vechotev iggerotav, kedigrasinan bechulin (sanhedrin tzav.):
Venaval ki yisba lachem. ze achashverosh sheasa mishte mea ushemonim yom (Ester 1:4):
(23) Senua ki tibbael. keneged yavan:
Veshifcha ki tirash gevirtah. ze esav, shehaya lo laavod leyaakov venehpach haddevarim:
(25) Hannemalim am lo az. zo bavel, shenneemar: "hen eretz kasdim ze haam lo haya" (Yeshayahu 23:13):

Vayyachinu vakkayitz lachmam. nevuchadnetztzar asa chavod echad lehakkadosh baruch hu bime merodach baladan asher shalach sefarim lechizkiyyahu vechatav sham: shelam lemalka chizkiyyahu, shelam lekarta dirushelem, shelam leelaha rabba. unevuchadnetztzar kotev iggerotav haya, velo haya sham oto hayyom; ucheshebba vesipperu lo ma sheasu, amar lahem: elaha rabba keritu leh uchetavitu leh besof? ratz achar hashshaliach vehecheziro. bishvil oto merutza zacha lammalchut; hare shehechin bakkayitz lachmo kederech hannemala (sanhedrin tzav.):
(26) Shefannim am lo-atzum. ze maday ufaras:
Vayyasimu vassela betam: shebbanu bet hammikdash:
(28) Shammamit beyadayim tetappes. ze esav shenneemar "vehayyadayim yede esav" (Bereshit 27:22):
Behechle melech. shennichnas lehechal melech vehecherivo:
(30) Layish gibbor babbehema. ze nevuchadnetztzar, shenneemar (Yirmeyahu 4:7) "ala arye missubbecho":
Zarzir matnayim. zo maday ufaras, shezzerzu matnehem vehargu levelshatztzar venatlu malchut bavel (Daniel 5:30):
O tayish. ze yavan shennikra tayish, shenneemar: "vehatztzafir hassair" hu "melech yavan" (Daniel 8:21):
Umelech alkum immo. zo ummat aram, sheamar "ani veafsi od" (yeshaya 47:8), en nitztzav leummato, alkum – en omed immo:
targum: Veakkacha demizdarez benat tarnegole uteyasha deazel bet giora umalka dekaem umemalel bet ammeh:

ohc: Vehaleviyyim lo hatpakdu vegomer kaasher vegomer. perush, hagam shemmispar ze mispar hakkavod vehammaala, sheasu keseder hammalachim sheyyardu im hashshechina behar sinay kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 2,3), af al pi chen lo vegomer, letzad ki mitzvat Adonai hi "lo tifkod velo tissa".

Velakachta chameshet vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar "velakachta" beVav, kevan shemmaamar ze hu gezerat maamar veet peduye hashshelosha vegomer? veulay ki baze heir kavvanat katuv hakkodem laze "veet peduye hashshelosha" vegomer, sheggezerato hu "mibbechor bene yisrael", perush sheyyikkach pidyon bechorot haodfim al haleviyyim meet habbechorot velo mehaleviyyim, shettaale al datecha lomar shekkederech sheppadu bevehemat haleviyyim behemtam kemo chen yifdu hannotarim mehem, vekal vachomer hu. talmud lomar "mibbechor bene yisrael", perush, yihye happidyon. vechen amar bammaase vayyikkach moshe vegomer meet bechor bene yisrael lakach et hakkasef, vehosif lomar mitzva sheniyya sheyyihye happidyon chameshet shekalim, vehu amro "velakachta" betosefet vav. vechazar lomar tikkach, sheyyikkach hashshekel beshekel hakkodesh shehu kaful, vesheddavar ze meakkev bappidyon.

rashi: Dor charavot shinnav. hachitzonot:
Metalleotav. shinnav happenimiyyot:
Umaachalot. sakkinim:
targum: Dara desafsere inun shinoy vecharife inun nivoy lemechal maskene meara velaalive min bene nasha:

rashi: Lachen hinne anochi mefatteha. meshaddela lehimmashech achari, 314 belaaz. umahu happittuy? veholachtiha hammidbar – baggola shehu lah kemidbar vetziyya, vesham tashiv el libbah ki tov lah kesheasta retzoni mikkeshemmarda bi (Hoshea 2:9):
targum: Bechen ha ana meshabad lah leorayta veabed lah nisin ugevuran kema daavadet lah bemadbera uveyad avde neviyaya amalel tanchumin al libbeha:

rashi: Laaluka. menachem patar laaluka kemashmao, lamadnu shehu aravi. vehappotrim omrim shehu leshon sheol umorad. vechen bemidrash tehillim lamadnu ken, sheppoter shete vanot – gan eden vegehinnom; zo omeret: tenu li tzaddikim, vezo omeret: tenu li reshaim:
Arba lo amru hon. harebe yesh lanu:
targum: Laaluka tarten benin hav hav telat inun dela savan vearba dela amran mista:

rashi: Eene et hashshamayim. litzok el hashshechakim mippeleg hattov hatteluyim bemaamar, vehem yaanu litzok mayim al haaretz:
targum: Vihe veidana hahi akabbel tzelotchon amar Adonai afkid yat shemaya veinun yachtun mitra al ara:

rashi: Imru laachechem ammi. ketargumo: "tuvu leorayti veal kenishtechon arachem":
targum: Neviyaya emaru laachechon ami tuvu leorayti veal kenishatchon arachem:

rashi: Rivu veimmechem. bichnesiyya shellachem shel achshav shehi em laddorot habbaim:
Mibben shadeha. derech hannoafot shemmemaachin lahem ben daddehem, veyonatan tirgem: "ufulechan tautaha mibben kiroha":
targum: Ochachu lichnishta deyisrael vaamaru lah are hi la mitanya befulechani umemri la mekabbel tzelotah ad detaade ovadaha bishaya mikovel appaha ufulechan taavataha mibben kirvaha:

rashi: Hinni sach. leshon 'segira, kemo "haser mesukkato" (Yeshayahu 5:5), "kimsuchat chadek" (Mishlei 15:19):
Et darkech. derachim ushevilim sheat holechet bahem:
targum: Bechen ha ana mekalkel yat orchatich kema desaygin bechuvaya veefsok kema demafsekin bechatlaya ushevilaha la tishkach:

ohc: Kol pekude haleviyyim vegomer. ramban zichrono livracha tama bedavar sheyyesh litmoah bo, ki haleviyyim hen hemma yedide Adonai ukerovav vaasher lo chatu baegel velo niggefu velo horagu velo husheku, veech nitmaatu kol kach mikkol hashshevatim sheenam maggiim bemisparam mibben chodesh lachatzi shevet hakkatan shebbeyisrael, velichshettaamod al misparam mibben esrim lo yaggia lishlish uleravia. veraiti sheyyishshev bishne derachim: haechad hu letzad sheharibbuy ba mitztzad hainnuy, dichtiv (Shemot 1:12) "vechaasher yeannu oto ken yirbe" vegomer, vederech sheni mittaam kaaso shel yaakov avinu alav hashshalom. uveenay taam hashsheni rachok, ki lo nimtza roshem hameatat hazzera bechaas avihem alav hashshalom. veod timtza bammispar habba bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 1 23:3) hayu haleviyyim shemona usheloshim elef mibben sheloshim shana ad ben chamishshim shana, uvemisparam befarashat naso bau lichlal cheshbon shemonat alafim vachamesh meot ushemonim, nimtzeu shehosifu arbaa chalakim bekeruv al mispar ze, uvemispar bene yisrael habba sham lo bau lechefel mispar haamur kan, uveomed mispar ze lichsheyyihyu nimnim mibben esrim ad ben mea vamala kederech shennimnim yisrael yachol lihyot misparam kigdol shivte yisrael vamala veayye kaas avihem?

Vetaam harishon shel hainnuy hu taam nachon, aval lo yutzdak lefi maamar chazal (Bereshit Rabba 79:1) sheamru lo met yaakov ad shehiggiu yisrael lichlal mispar shishshim ribbo. uvehechreach leyashshev hakketuvim lefi divrehem zichrono livracha ki amro "ken yirbe", perush, kemo chen bashshiur harishon yirbe, velo haya mitmaet hagam shehayu horgim mehem umeannim otam, haya koach beyisrael lifrot velirbot kammishpat harishon lemalleot hechaser. uma sheamar hakkatuv (Shemot 1,7) "uvene yisrael paru vegomer vayyakutzu mippene" vegomer, letzad ki bime yaakov hayu ketanne ketannim velo hayu osim roshem bair, uchesheggadlu asu pirsum. umeatta haribbuy haya kodem hainnuy, velamma lo yihye chen leshevet levi? veen lomar shehayu kemo chen rabbim kishar hashshevatim beet petirat avihem venitmaatu achar kach, uletzad shello haya bahem hainnuy lo chazru lehitrabbot, ki gam al ze dan anochi lamma yitmaatu mibberacha rishona. verazal amru (Bamidbar Rabba 5:1) shehaya haaron mechalle bahem, ze haya achar minnuy avodat haleviyyim.

Vehannachon beenay hu, ki shevet levi maase echad lahem kemaase amram asher shillach et ishto bishvil gezerat habben hayyillod. vehattaam, letzad shehayu meunnagim velo nishtabedu, lo namas levavam kol kach lirot netiehem mushlachim bayor, kemaase ish yisrael asher mitztzad hashshibud veol haavoda huzal vehukal beenehem uvelibbam lirot yaldehem mushlachim bayor. gam shehayu mezalzelim beatzman leled velaazov bassadot uvimchillot haaretz, asher en adam nichbad shennafsho mechubbedet alav keshevet levi ose chen. veze lecha haot ki amram shillach et ishto, velo hutzrach hakkatuv lehodia et haddavar, sheggam beamram lo higgid hakkatuv hainyan ella mehasekalat hainyan noda, ulelammed al kol shivto yatza. vezo hi sibbat miutam, ki im en gedayim en teyashim. vahagam shemmatzinu sheamram hechzir gerushato, en lilmod mimmennu shekkullam hechziru, ki hu ze asher ba elav haddavar binvua kemaamar chazal baaggada (Shemot Rabba 81, sota 12.) uvedivre hazzohar hakkadosh (chelek 2 11:) befasuk "vayyelech ish" vegomer, uchemo sheamru gam ken (Shemot Rabba 81) befasuk "vattetatztzav achoto" vegomer, shehalcha lirot ma yihye binvuatah.

Veim tomar, lamma shevet ben tora yaase miut periyya verviyya. ulay sheddanu vah lemaan lo niga larik velo neled labbehala (Yeshayahu 65:23), vechayyotze vaze matzinu sheamru (taanit 11.) sheasur leshammesh mittato bishnat reavon hagam sheyyesh meniat periyya verviyya, vedanu kemo chen letzad killuy habbanim hazzecharim nimneu kol ikkar, umeatta adrabba asa Adonai immahem nes shennisharu mehem mispar ze, velaze achar zeman shehayu asukim gam hem befirya verivya paru vayyishretzu vegomer yoter mishshear hashshevatim.

Seu et rosh vegomer. tzarich ladaat mispar ze lamma. verashi zichrono livracha hevi divre hammidrash sheamru ki keshebba lehasherot shechinato betocham chazar limnotam, ad kan, veze lo yaspik leyishshuv happeshat, ki haya lo limnotam kodem chodesh nisan lo achar kach, gam behafelagat zeman chodesh yamim.

Venire li behakedim lachkor zot, ki bammispar sheachar haegel shehu mispar shebbefarashat pekude (shemot 38:26) bau lichlal cheshbon shesh meot elef usheloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim, sheyyesh bemispar ze nosaf al mispar yotze mitzrayim sheloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim behemshech zeman shishsha chodashim, hagam shekkilla bahem haegel bishlosha mine mitot: maggefa, cherev bene levi, hashekaat efer haegel. uvammispar shellefanenu shehu achar shishsha chodashim acherim mimmispar hashsheni, roani shello hosifu al mispar hakkodem lo afillu echad. vehaddavar kimat zar limod shello hosifu, sheech yittachen shebbehemshech zeman ze lo yavou mehem lichlal esrim, uma gam shello era lahem chissaron venosaf shehayu asukim bimlechet hammishkan.

Veyigdal hakkusheya lefi ma sheamru bappesikta (zavetaretaa), veze leshonam: "vayyihyu kol happekudim" vegomer, ulehallan hu omer "beka vegomer leshesh meot elef" vegomer, lamadnu shekkol zeman shehayu yisrael asukin bimlechet hammishkan lo chasra mehem nefesh achat, ad kan. divrehem zichronam livracha lefi hannire rechokim, shehalo adrabba behasekil al davar anu roim shechasru yoter mimma shechasru bemaase haegel, hagam shello hayu asukim bimlechet hammishkan.

Achen lefi ma sheala beyadenu shekkol shevet levi shoklim shekalim (shekalim 1,3), en kushya, ki bammispar shebbefarashat pekude hayu haleviyyim bichlal hammispar, aval bammispar shellefanenu lo nichnesu haleviyyim, umeatta hare shehosifu kol mispar haleviyyim, velaze amar besamuch lammispar vehaleviyyim lo hatpakdu betoch bene yisrael, velo haya tzarich lomar shehinni roe shello hatpakdu bammispar hakkodem, vehen emet im amar hakkatuv kaasher tzivva Adonai kemo sheamar hakkatuv achar parashat haddegalim hayiti omer ki ba lehashemienu shekkiyyemu maamar Adonai shetztzivva shello yifkedu otam, umimma shello amar ella vehaleviyyim lo hatpakdu betocham hare ze mare baetzba ki nitkavven lomar, al titma al hammispar shehu beshave lammispar hakkodem belo tosefet – vehaleviyyim lo hatpakdu, vahare lefanecha hayyitron.

Uferush divre happesikta yatzitz vezarach, ki ma shemmatzinu cheshbon atzum kaze sheshshave bemispar sheni leshellefanim, ze yaggid ki hen henna shehayu bammispar harishon, uveshishsha chodashim shebben shete hammisparot lo nedar mehem echad, vehannosafin bammispar milleu chesron mispar haleviyyim shehayu bakkelal harishon velo bichlal mispar hashsheni. velaze nitchakkem Adonai lomar lemoshe laset et rosh bene yisrael beyom echad lachodesh hashsheni vegomer, bechiuun shehaya zeman shehiggia hammispar lammispar harishon levad haleviyyim, lehaircha bema sheamar bappesikta shehammispar atzmo harishon haya kammispar hashsheni velo met echad venichnas acher bimkomo. vehattaam, letzad shehayu asukim bimlechet hammishkan, al derech (Devarim 4:4) "veattem haddevekim baAdonai chayyim kullechem". venuchal lomar gam ledivre hammidrash shehevi Rashi shekkeshebba lehasherot shechinato betocham vechulei, shebbachar bizman ze lattaam hannizkar.

Elle shemot vegomer hammeshuchim vegomer. chazar lomar elle shemot paam sheniyya, velo hispik bema sheamar befaam rishona "elle shemot" vegomer veligmor omer hammeshuchim vegomer, nitkavven lemaet shello nimshechu ella ellu, velaze dikdek lomar elle lemaet zulatam, umippasuk rishon lo nishma ze letzad sheamar "veelle" shello tishma sheppasal im bene yisrael shekkadmu lahem, vehaven.

rashi: Vehaya mispar. ma inyan puranut venechama semuchin bedibbur echad? verabbotenu pershu bifsachim (fesachim paz,2): hirgish hoshea beatzmo shechata al sheamar "hachalifem", amad uvikkesh alehem rachamim. uvesifre deve rav parashat "vayyeshev yisrael bashshittim" (Bamidbar 25:1) shaninu: rabbi omer, yesh parashiyyot semuchot zo lazo urechokot zo mizzo kirchok mizrach mimmaarav – "ki attem lo ammi" vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam". ma inyan ze etzel ze? mashal lemelech shekkaas al ishto, shalach achar hassofer lavo velichtov lah get. ad shello ba hassofer, nitratztza hammelech leishto. amar hammelech: "efshar yetze sofer ze mikkan chaluk?" kelomar libbo chaluk vetohe lomar "lamma shalach acharay?" amar lo: "bo uchetov lah sheani kofel lah ketubbatah". ulefi feshuto kach hi semichato: "ki attem lo ammi veanochi lo ehye lachem" – ere atzmi keillu eni lachem, vetiglu leven haummot, veaf sham tirbu vetitzmechu, vesham tashuvu el levavchem lashuv elay, kemo shenneemar al yede moshe (Devarim 30:1): "vahashevota el levavecha bechol haggoyim asher hiddichacha vegomer veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha vegomer" (Devarim 30:3). af kan: "venikbetzu bene yehuda uvene yisrael yachdav vegomer" (Hoshea 2:2):
targum: Vihe minyan bene yisrael kechala deyama dela mittechol udela mitmene vihe beatra deitgeliu bene ammaya kad avaru al orayta veitamar lehon la ami attun yetuvun veyitrabbun veyitamar lehon ameh deelaha keyama:

rashi: Im navalta vehitnasse. im nitnabbalta al yede chavercha shecherfecha (0 al yede dabburecha shecherafta vegiddafta) et atzmecha, sofcha lehinnase baddavar:
Veim zammota. belibbecha lehitkotet, sim yad al pe ushetok:
targum: La titroram dela titappesh vela toshit aydach lefumach:

rashi: Umachata. kofa piha lematta, kedichtiv "kaasher yimche hatztzallachat macha vehafach al paneha" (Melachim 2 21:13):
Achla. lashon nekiyya dibber hakkatuv (yoma 75.):
targum: Hechna archa deitteta gayarta achla umechappera pumah veamra la avadet midaam reata:

rashi: Betzedek uvemishpat. shettitnahagu bahen:

Uvechesed uverachamim. sheyyavo lecha meitti al yedehem. beavraham avinu ketiv (Bereshit 18:19): "ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve vegomer laasot tzedaka umishpat", uchenegdan natan levanav chesed verachamim meet hakkabba, shenneemar (Devarim 13:18): "venatan lecha rachamim", "veshamar Adonai elohecha lecha et habberit veet hachesed" (sham 17). pasku min hatztzedaka vehammishpat, kemo shenneemar (Amos 5:7): "hahofchim lallaana mishpat utzedaka laaretz hinnichu", af hakkabba asaf mehem hachesed veharachamim, shenneemar (Yirmeyahu 15:1): "ki asafti et shelomi meet haam hazze et hachesed veet harachamim". uchesheyyachzeru laasot tzedaka umishpat, shenneemar (Yeshayahu 1:27): "tziyyon bemishpat tippade vegomer", hakkabba mosif alehem rachamim vachesed, veose otan atara learbatan umoshivan beroshan:
targum: Veekayminchon kodamay laalam veekayminchon kodamay bekusheta uvedina uvechisda uverachame:

ohc: Kol zachar mibben chodesh vegomer. taam mibben chodesh, kefi zeman asher bau hemma tachtehem shehem habbechorot, velamma yitten habbechor pidyono kevan sheyyesh lo ben levi bimkomo? veim tomar lamma en haleviyyim podim kemo chen meaz vahala et habbechorot, velo yitztarchu yisrael pidyon livchorehem? yesh lomar ki otam haleviyyim kevar nichnesu tachat habbechorot shehayu az, veet benehem hekim Adonai tachat avotehem, shehare nitkaddeshu hem uvenehem ad olam. veulay ki laze kafal Adonai bemaamaro bema shekkatav bappasuk vaani hinne lakachti et haleviyyim vegomer vehayu li haleviyyim, perush huchletu hem uvene venehem, meatta en levi sheyyifde bechor yisrael habba achar ken peter rechem.

Kol yotze tzava. amar hakkatuv ken bechol perate hammispar, lomar shello haya echad mikkol habbaim lichlal hammispar shello haya rauy latzet batztzava, ella kullan gibbore koach, vehu amro kol, perush, kol echad mehem yotze tzava. veze nes sheeno baummot, shei efshar shello yimmatze bechol hammisparim shellahem echad sheeno rauy latzet batztzava:

Veet behemat haleviyyim vegomer. perush, habbehemot shehem chayyavim befidyon shehem pitre chamorim, sheamar hakkatuv (Shemot 13:13) "ufeter chamor tifde vese", vedavka peter chamor aval bechorot hattehorot lo, ki hattemimin enam bene fidyon, uvaale mumin mishshennaasu bene mumin rega echad birshut [habbealim], (habbechor) zacha bo vahare hu etzlo kechullin uma makom lefidyon.

rashi: Veish lo yatztzilenna miyyadi. af zechut avotam tamma (shabbat noah,1):
targum: Uchean agale yat kelanah leene ammaya rachamaha veenash la yeshezvinah min yedi:

ohc: Toldot aharon umoshe vegomer. velo mana ella toldot aharon, lomar ki bene aharon yechashvu al moshe letzad shehu hitpallel baadam vechayu, dichtiv (Devarim 9:20) "uveaharon hitannaf Adonai lehashemido" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 7:1) shehoila tefillato lehatztzil elazar veitamar.

Veamro beyom dibber vegomer, lomar zeman shehitpallel alehem, vechalal od baze sibbat kabbalat tefillato shehu letzad sheddibber Adonai elav behar sinay venaasa tzir neeman laAdonai bekabbalat hattora:

rashi: Velo yizzachru od yisrael bishmam shel bealim, o lo yizzachru habbealim bishmam shel yisrael lomar shehem elahut lahem, o lo yizzacher shem habbealim od, kema deamar (Yeshayahu 2:18) "vehaelilim kalil yachalof":
targum: Veade yat shum taavat ammaya mippumehon vela yehe dachran shumehon od:

rashi: Immam. kenesiyya shellahem:

Hovisha horatam. behitu malfehon (targum yonatan) hachachamim hammorim lahem horaot, boshim mippene amme haaretz. omrim lahem: "lo tignovu" (Vayikra 19:11), vehem gonvim. lo talvu veribbit (Vayikra 25:37), vehem malvim:
Achare meahavay. bedarche haakkum (Shemot Rabba 46:4):
targum: Are teat kenishtehon batar neviye shikra behitu malfehon are amra ehach batar ammaya rachame mesappeke mechli umishti kesut mela uvutz meshach kol parnusay:

ohc: Lo tifkod vegomer lo tissa. perush, ben al yede kofer nefesh ben shello al yede kofer nefesh. veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat ki tissa.
Od yechavven lomar, shehagam sheyyavo leyadcha mispar shel nesiut umaala shehu mispar haddegalim, af al pi chen lo tissa.

rashi: Tikrei ishi vegomer. taavduni meahava velo miyyira, ishi leshon ishut vechibbat neurim (yirmeya 2:2):
Bali. leshon adnut umora, verabbotenu pershu (fesachim paz,1; ketuvot 71,2): kechalla bevet chamiha, velo kechalla bevet aviha:
targum: Vihe beidana hahi amar Adonai titnehon lefulechani vela tiflechun od letaavat ammaya:

rashi: Semamit. arinya belaaz:
Beyadayim tetappes. beyadah hi ochezet umitdabbeket bakketalim (Bereshit Rabba 66,7):
targum: Veakmeta dimsachcha vidaha veamda beveta demalche:

rashi: Ufakadti aleha. sechar puranut:
Yeme habbealim asher taktir: tamid lahem, velashon hove hu.
Vattaad nizmah vechelyatah. leshon 'adi, kezona hammitkashshetet likrat noafim:
Vechelyatah. bilshon arvi hu kishshut:
targum: Veasar ala yat yomaya dahavat palcha letaavata demaska lehon busemin vahavat damya leitteta deshavkat yat baalah veitkinat bikdashaha uvachalitat margelitaha uteet batar rachamaha ken kenishat yisrael rechimat lemiflach letaavata ufulechani shavkat amar Adonai:

rashi: Rosh echad. david malkam:
Ki gadol yom. kibbutz zeriatam:
targum: Veyitkanshun bene yehuda uvene yisrael kachada vimanun lehon resh chad min bet david veyiskun min ara galutehon are rav yom kenishathon:

rashi: Keyom hivvaldah. keyom shemmetzatiha bemitzrayim, kemo shemmeforash bichezkel (Yechezkel 16:4-5): "umoladtech beyom hulledet otach lo charat sharech … vattushlechi el pene hassade begoal nafshech lo chasa alayich ayin":
Kammidbar. gezerot sheggazarti alehem bammidbar, sham "yittammu vesham yamutu" (Bamidbar 14:35):
Vahamitiha. "veektelinna":
targum: Dilma asalek shechinti minah veade yekarah veashvinah retisha keyomaya kadmae ad la itkerivat lefulechani veyachul rugezi alah kema dechal al am dara daavaru al orayti bemadbera vaashave ara tzadya veektelinah bevatzorta:

ohc: Laasot melacha. shinna mehaamur baavodat bene gershon uvene merari "laavod avoda" veamar laasot melacha, heir baze sheen bichlalut maase bene kehat avoda, letzad shehaaron hu adrabba nose et nosav (Bamidbar Rabba 84), veen osin bo ella melacha. od nire ki letzad sheyyesh lahem laasot seder nachon bemassaam keshennosim bakkatef vechiuun hahalicha letzad kevod aron elohim kenose adono al ketefo, laze kara avodatam melacha, ma sheen ken avodat bene gershon uvene merari:

Vayyitten moshe vegomer kaasher tzivva Adonai vegomer. kashe, achar sheamar hakkatuv al pi Adonai, ma makom lomar kaasher tzivva Adonai vegomer? venire ki letzad sheyyesh bemaase ze hatava leaharon achiv uvanav, veyesh makom lomar ki haya lemoshe nachat ruach lehetiv leachiv, laze ba hakkatuv veshalal bechinat machshava zo mimmoshe, shello chashav bemaase ze retzon hannetina leachiv ella lekayyem maamar Adonai haya lo hachefetz bemaasehu.

rashi: Lo yada. lo sama el libbah, veheret atzmah kelo yodaat:
Vechesef hirbeti lah vezahav. vehem asauhu labbaal:
targum: Veinun la yadin are ana barchet lehon ibbura vechamra umishcha vechaspa asgeti lehon vedahava mineh avadu letaavata:

rashi: Pen esba. mittoch osher, vechichashti bahakkadosh baruch hu merov gaava. umahu hakkechasha?
Veamarti mi Adonai. kelomar: en elohim:
Vetafasti shem elohay. leharegil lehishshava bo lashsheker:
targum: Dela esba veechpar veemar manu elaha udela itmasken veegnov vaachalel shemeh delaha:

rashi: Veerastich li beemuna. bischar haemuna sheheemant baggola lahavetachot sheal yede neviay (mechilta beshallach vayhi 6):
targum: Veekayminchon kodamay behemanuta vetidun lemidchal min kodam Adonai:

rashi: Im chayyat hassade sheashbit mazzikin min haolam, vechen hu omer (yeshaya 11:9): "lo yareu velo yashchitu vegomer":
targum: Veegzar lehon keyam beidana hahi dihon shelam im chayat bera veim ofa dishmaya verachasha deara vekashta vecharba veavde kerava avatel min ara veashrinun lerochatzan:

rashi: Al talshen eved. al timsor din al adam litzok alav lehakkadosh baruch hu, vaafillu hu rasha asher aviv yekallel, vechol hattoevot haamurot kan bo. ureaya laddavar mehoshea ben beeri, kidita bifsachim beferek 'haishsha (fesachim paz.), shehilshin et yisrael veamar: hachalifem beumma acheret! amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: "kach lecha eshet zenunim" (Hoshea 1:2):
targum: La talshen avda lemareh dela netzaarinach vetitchayev:

rashi: Resh. dallut:
Haterifeni. leshon mazon, vechen "teref natan lireav" (tehillim 111:5):
targum: Rigleta umilta chadvuta archek mini miskenuta veutera la titten li zuni lachma misti:

rashi: Beitto. beet gemar bishshul happerot:
Vehitztzalti. mimmenna:

Tzamri ufishti asher haya lechassot et ervatah, kol 'hatztzala shebbammikra leshon teruma vehaferasha hu, umochiach alav "vayyatztzel elohim et mikne avichem" (Bereshit 31:9), "ki chol haosher asher hitztzil" (sham):
targum: Bechen yetuv memri lemital ibbura beidan idreh vechamra beidan maatzarteh veatzil chesut mela uvutz dihavet lah lechasa yat kelanah:

ohc: Vehachonim vegomer. amar vehachonim betosefet vav, letzad shekkadam mitzvat chaniyya saviv lammishkan hosif lehatenot sidran.

targum: Techot avda kad nimloch vetappesha deyisba lachma:
Arbea inun dizirin beara vehinun chakkimin umachkemin:
Archa denishra vishmaya veorcheh dechivya al shua veorcha deilfa belibbe deyama vearcha degavra veulemta:
Arya gibbar bivira vela hafich min kol midaam:
Techot senuata dehavya legavra veamta di yarta leribbontah:
Dara dedache veaynoy umitzaateh la ishtezag:
Vekamtze demalka let lehon umitkanshin kulhon kachada:
Vachanase deamhon la takif veavdin lehon beta biktarin:
Shomshemanay la asin amhon umetaknin bekayta mechalhon:
Veyat benaha la arachem are venin detaan inun:
Techot telat rugeza ara utechot arba la yachla lemisbera:
Vaavatel kol chedvataha chagaha yarchaha veshabbattaha vechol moadaha:
Dara daavuhi netzaar uleimeh la nevarech:

bart: Kol harauy littamme teme met. betzemer ufishtim o veor:

Af al pi sheeno mittamme midras. kegon beged shalosh al shalosh, deeno mittamme midras ad sheyyehe vo shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim, umittamme vemet. vechol shekken shekkol hammittammein midras mittammein bannegaim, uvilvad bilvanim sheenam tzevuim:
Kela shel sefina uvilon vechulei. kol hane dachashiv, mittammein bemet veen mittammeim midras:
Shavis. leshon hashshevisim vehassaharonim hakkatuv bishaya (perek 3):
Vegalgillon. avnet shechogrim bo:
Sagos. beged av meod vehu keadderet sear:
Baarig uvammochin. beguf haadderet uvassearot habboltim mimmenna. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov:

Hachemet vehatturemal. kelim shel or, vekoshrim otan venichpal haor bimkom hakkesher, veen hannega shebbichfalav nire ella im ken mitpashshet haor. ulehachi katane nirin kedarkan, kelomar sheen poshto, ella roehu chach kemot shehu. chemet, nod shel or. turemal, kemin kis gadol shel or sheharoe manniach chafatzav betocho:
Mittocho laachorav. im mittechilla nira nega betocho vehisgiro, uvesof shavua nira nega baachorav mibbachutz, chashiv pisyon. uvattosefta mashma dedavka veorot amrinan hachi, velo vivgadim:
Bayit hammusgar metamme mittocho. kedichtiv vehabba el habbayit kol yeme hisgir oto yitma ad haarev. vehaavanim hamenuggaim atzman, afillu vemusgar metammein meachorehen:
Vehammuchlat mittocho umeachorav. hannogea babbayit meachorav, tame, dichtiv bemuchlat, tzaraat mameret babbayit tame hu, ma talmud lomar tame hu, hosif lo sheyyehe tame ben mittocho ben meachorav:
Ze vaze metammein bevia. letamme kol hannichnas betocho:
Bayit sheachad mitztzedadav. echad mearbaa chetalav mechuppe veshayish 481:
Besela. tzor shehu sham mishsheshet yeme vereshit:
Bilvenim. asuyim bechivshan:
Beafar. shehakkotel asuy miggushe afar:
Tahor. devainan sheyyihyu arbaa kirot habbayit reuyin littamme vannegaim, veim echad min hakkirot asuy bedavar sheen rauy littamme, kegon kol hane deamrinan, habbayit tahor:
Bayit shello hayu vo avanim veetzim veafar. kol shelashtan, ella echad mehen haya vo, venira hannega beoto haechad, tahor. devainan sheyyehe rauy littamme kodem reiyyat hannega:
Ad sheyyihyu vo avanim veetzim veafar. dichtiv (Vayikra 14) et avanav veet etzav veet kol afar habbayit:
Meniach et hechavit. mishshello, im yirtze, veaz tzarich lezakkot, deillu mishshellahem en tzarich lezakkot:

Umezakke lahem al yede veno uvitto. omer lahem kabbelu chavit zo uzechu bah leshem kol bene hammavoy. vehazzoche magbiah haeruv beyado tefach min hakkarka, dechol hecha demancha birshuteh lo haveya zechiyya, veomer zikkiti lahem:
Sheyyadan keyado. velav zechiyya hi:
Kayta. malbush shergilim lilbosh bimot hachamma. targum kayitz, kayta. veli nire shehu lashon romi shekkorim lemalbush shel ishsha 136:
Sheyyesh lah pispasin. menummeret bitzvaim harebe, lavan veyarok veshachor vedomehen. pispasin leshon pas yad, sheppissat yad mibbeged lavan ufissat yad mibbeged shel tzeva:
Ulevanim posim mizze laze. millavan lelavan. veaf al pi shehatztzavua mafsik, chashuv pisyon. defisyon rachok metamme vechaggeris:
Vahare hu fispas yechidi. kelomar, im lo haya vo ella fispas echad lavan, vechol shear happispasin tzevuin, mi vae hesger, o lo, mishshum deen lo lehechan yifse:
Amar lahen lo shamati. kelomar, kibbalti merabbotay detaun hesger, velo fershu li hattaam lamma:
Alammed bo. kelomar, tarsheni lomar lefanecha taam laddavar:
Im lefaresh divre chachamim hen. shello tistor ma shekkibbalti:
Shemma yaamod shene shavuot. sheaf al pi sheen lo vamme yifse yachol lavo lide tuma, im yaamod beenav shene shavuot:
Happisyon hassamuch. kesheppose samuch laom:
Harachok. shehaom berosh echad shel beged vehappisyon berosho hashsheni:
Hachozer. kegon shekkaha vashsheni dekoro vesoref ma shekkara, uchetiv veim terae od babbeged vesaraf vegomer. vezehu hachozer, veshiuro vechaggeris:
Vaafillu hayu mea. kittot sheheidu zo achar zo beedut achat vechat achat hezemma et kullan, kullan yeharegu:

Istasit hi zot. kelomar zot hakkat sara vesatya hi, shekkach natlu etza venehen lehazzim kol habba lehaid beedut zot. perush acher istasit hi zo, vechi edut zo yora shel istis hi shetztzovaat kol hannogea bah:

Veenah nehereget ella chat rishona vilvad. disvira leh lerabbi yehuda dilachar deittazzemma la chat rishona, tu lo mekabbelim sahaduta dechat sheniyya deatya leashid batra, vei assahada veittazzemma lo katlinan la, delo karinan la vaasitem lo, deha lo katlinan appumma. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Bishyare haeruv. shennitmaet mishshiuro:

Velo amru learev bachatzerot. achar shennishtattefu bammavoy, ella shello tishtakkach torat eruve chatzerot mittinokot sheenan yodin shennishtattefu bammavoy, hilkach mekilinan beh. veaf al gav detaama dimarvin eruve chatzerot leachar shennishtattefu bammavoy have kede shello tishtakkach torat eruv min hattinokot, mikkol makom en halacha kerabbi yose bishyare eruv, delo mekilinan beh kulle hay:
Ammat hammayim. afillu birshut hayyachid karmelit hi:
Asu lah mechitztza. betoch ognah al pene rachbah, shehu nikkar shebbishvil hammayim naaset:

Baamma shel avel. shem hair, vehayta overet betoch hachatzerot umemallein mimmenna bachatzerot, dimhanya la mechitztzot kotel hechatzer hatteluyot aleha. verabbi yehuda letaameh, defaleg nammi abbor, veen halacha kemoto:

Shello haya vah kashshiur. karmelit. shello haya amok asara o lo haya rachav arbaa, sheen hammayim naasin reshut leatzman lehechashev karmelit ella im ken amok asara verachav arbaa. asu lah bakkenisa velo baytzia lo mehanne mide, deha mechubberet lammayim shechutz lechatzer bitziato venaaset hakkol karmelit. [asu lah vaytzia velo bakkenisa nammi lo mehanne, deha mechubberet lammayim shellemala chutz lechatzer zo. aval asu lah bakkenisa uvaytzia mehanne, shennire] keillu matchilin bechatzer zo:
Rabbi shimon omer notnan lachavero. veeno molichan pachot [pachot] mearba ammot keshemmityare mippene listim, gezera shemma yaavirem mittechillat arba lesof arba. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Vechen beno. sheyyeladto immo bassade beshabbat:
Notno lachavero. veha adifa milletaltelo pachot pachot mearba ammot:
Afillu chutz lattechum. bechavit shel hefker mayre, dei yesh lah bealim ha kayma lan habbehema vehakkelim keragle habbealim, vesavar rabbi yehuda nichse hefker lo kanu shevita:
Amru lo. rabbi yochanan ben nuri hu deamar la, deshaminan leh deamar nichse hefker konin shevita bimkoman:

Lo tehallech zo yoter meragle vealeha. kelomar im hayu lah bealim velo ervu lo hayta mehallechet ella alpayim amma, hasheta nammi lo telech ella alpayim amma mimmekom shevitatah. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hakkore vassefer. kol sefarim shellahem hayu niglalim kesefer tora shellanu:
Haaskuppa. keen itztabba shellifne petach habbayit, vecharmelit hi:
Gollo etzlo. hoil verosho echad beyado:

Laasara tefachim. hattachtonim hassemuchim lekarka shel reshut harabbim, deim en agdo veyado have issur deorayta, vegazrinan agdo beyado attu sheen agdo veyado. uvaggemara parech veha lo nach, kelomar af al pi shehiggia laasara tefachim hattachtonim en kan issura deorayta afillu lo haya agdo veyado, shehare lo nach birshut harabbim, umeshane kegon shehaya sham kotel meshuppa, venach hassefer al belitat hakkotel shel asara tefachim hattachtonim, dahave keillu nach birshut harabbim, veim lo haya agdo veyado have chiyyuva deorayta im haya mevio etzlo. umatnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, higgia laasara tefachim min haaretz hofcho al hakketav, bamme devarim amurim bechotel meshuppa denach, aval bechotel sheeno meshuppa gollo etzlo, divre rabbi yehuda, sherabbi yehuda omer afillu eno mesullak min haaretz ella melo hachut gollo etzlo, devainan hannacha al gabbe mashshehu:
Hofcho al hakketav. haotiyyot kelappe hakkotel, shello yehe muttal kol kach bevizzayon, umannicho sham ad shettechshach:

Davar mishshum shevut. kegon ze sheagdo beyado velekka ki im shevut derabbanan im ba legollo etzlo, sheen chayyav min hattora ella im ken yatza hassefer kullo miyyado venach birshut harabbim uva leakro mershut harabbim ulehannicho birshut hayyachid. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Ketzad. lechol mi sheyyelech levet haevel vechulei. demile demitzva ninhu, vekayma lan en mearvin eruve techumin ella lidvar mitzva:
Vechol mi shekkibbel alav. lismoch al eruv ze muttar:
Umishshechashecha asur. vehane mille keshello hodiuhu mibbeod yom, aval hodiuhu mibbeod yom afillu lo kibbel alav lismoch al eruv ze bevadday ella mishshechashecha, muttar:

Veechad matre vo baemtza. hammatre mitztaref im hakkat shel edim, shehu roe otam vehem roim oto bishat hahatraa. lefichach im hayu shete hakkittot shebbishne hachallonot roim oto, mitztarfim ellu im ellu vehem kullam edut echat:
Hu vahen neheragin. hu neherag deakkatti ikka chat achat shello huzamma, vehem hannizzamin neheragin shehare huzammu:
Shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi hatturgeman. shetztzerichin sheyyihyu haddayyanim makkirim bilshon haedim velo yitztarchu lehaamid melitz benotam. vechen halacha:
Bayit shehu mesech al gabbe vayit hamenugga. kegon shebbayit hamenugga banuy betoch bayit acher. vechen ilan shebbayit hamenugga banuy tachtav:
Hannichnas lachitzon tahor. dehay lechodeh kae vehay lechodeh kae. vedame levayit vaaliyya, dei kae metzora babbayit, aliyya tehora:
Uma im even achat. shemmibbayit hamenugga, metammea kol asher baohel:
Habbayit kullo. shehu tachat bayit acher, lo chol shekken sheyyetamme kol ma shebbetoch hachitzon. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:
Ketzad haedim naasim zommin. hachi kaamar, otan edim shennimtzeu zommin veen osin bahen din hazamma, kelomar sheen mekayyemin bahem vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv, ketzad hen naasim zommim:
Meidin anu veish peloni. kohen:
Shehu ven gerusha. befanenu nitgarsha immo kodem shennolad vahare hu chalal:

En omrim. im huzammu vehem kohanim yease ze ben gerusha lekayyem bo kaasher zamam, deha chetiv (Devarim 19) vaasitem lo kaasher zamam, lo velo lezaro. veim taasehu chalal vehu chohen, pasalta et zaro leolam. veim tomar nifsol oto levaddo velo zaro, bainan kaasher zamam laasot velekka, shehare hu zamam lifsol hanniddon veet zaro:

Ella loke arbaim. deamar kera (sham 25) vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik vehirshiu et harasha vehaya im bin hakkot harasha, mishshum dehirshiu et harasha, vehaya im bin hakkot harasha, ella, edim shehirshiu et hatztzaddik vaatu ede acharine vehitzdiku et hatztzaddik demeikkara veshavvinhu lehanach reshaim, vehaya im bin hakkot harasha:
En omrim yigle ze. dichtiv berotzeach (sham 19) hu yanus, hu velo zommav:
Sheggerash et ishto. befanenu beyom peloni, veze omer lo gerashti veeni chayyav lah ketubba:

Vehallo ben hayyom uven lemachar. kelomar ma yeshallemu lo, im tomar kol hakketubba, vahalo shemma yamut o shemma yegarshenna hayyom o lemachar vesofo litten lah, nimtza shello hayu mafsidin oto kelum:
Omdin kamma adam rotze litten bichtubbatah shel zo. missafek. sheim nitalmena o nitgarsha yittelenna lokeach, veim meta yirashenna valah veyafsid meotav shennatan, vechach yittenu haedim labbaal:

Mirpeset. makom gavoah bachatzar habbayit, veharebe pitche aliyyot petuchin lah, vechullam yotzin besullam echad lechatzer umimmennu lirshut harabbim, veaf al pi chen en osrin hoil umirpeset gevoha asara, uvilvad sheyyearvu bene mirpeset leatzman bammirpeset, dehavya regel hammutteret bimkomah veenah oseret:
Sheshshachchu velo ervu. ellu im ellu. aval ervu ellu leatzman veellu leatzman:

Kol sheggavoah asara. im yesh bechatzer tel o ammud gavoah asara samuch lammirpeset veen mirpeset gavoah min haammud asara, denicha tashmishteh deammud livne hammirpeset, reshut mirpeset sholetet bo umishtamshin hen bo velo bene hechatzer:
Pachot mikkan lechatzer. af lechatzer kaamar, sheshshete harshuyyot sholtin bo, hammirpeset vehechatzer, veim lo ervu ze im ze shenehem asurim bo:

Chulyat habbor. sefat habbor shel mala, im gavoah asara min hechatzer reshut mirpeset sholetet bo. vehu sheyyihye habbor male ad sefato haelyona middevarim sheasur letaltelam beshabbat, dehashta i efshar shettechsar miggavhah, dumeya desela sheeno chaser, vahare hu shave lekarkait hammirpeset, aval im en habbor male o afillu male middevarim sheefshar likkach mehem beshabbat ulechassero, kevan dechi chasra asira, ki lo chasra nammi asira, veim lo ervu hammirpeset vehechatzer ze im ze shenehem asurim bo:
Afillu gavoah asara tefachim lechatzer. af lechatzer kemo lammirpeset, ushenehem asurim bo im lo ervu ze im ze:

Loke veeno meshalleach. disvira leh lerabbi yehuda shalleach teshalach meikkara mashma. veaf al gav dichtiv shalleach teshallach achar lo tikkach, lav lememra deim lakachta teshalach, ella lo tikkach aval shallechenna kodem lekicha. veen ze lav hannittak laase:
Vachachamim omrim meshalleach veeno loke. kasavre shalleach leachar lekicha mashma, vehave lav hannittak laase. vahalacha kachachamim:

Kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase. sheamra tora im avarta al lav kayyem haase, kegon lo tikkach haem al habbanim, veim lakachta shalleach teshallach. lo tavo el beto laavot avoto, veim bata vehaavatta avoto hashev tashiv lo et haavot. kol ellu, im kiyyem haase, eno loke. aval lo kiyyem haase, kegon shellakach haem al habbanim ushechatah o shemmeta, lakach haavot mibbeto venisraf sheeno yachol lekayyem haase, hare ze loke:
Hatztzevuim. afillu vide shamayim:
Habbattim ben tzevuim. afillu vide adam:

Haorot kabbattim. vaafillu tzevuim bide adam mittammein bannegaim. vahalacha shehabbegadim en mittammein tzevuim, vaafillu vide shamayim, dichtiv [sham] beveged tzemer o beveged pishtim, ma pishtim kivriyyato, af tzemer kivriyyato. uchetiv lappishtim velatztzamer, ma pishtim lavan, af tzemer lavan. veorot hatztzevuim bide adam en mittammein bannegaim. aval bide shamayim mittammein bannegaim, kedivre rabbi shimon:

Vehattahor over tame. dichtiv bimtzora, michutz lammachane moshavo, mikkan shemmoshavo tame. hilkach keshehattame omed tachat hailan, naase mekom hailan moshavo vehattahor haover sham tame. aval keshehattame over veeno omed lafush sham, en ze karuy moshavo, veaf al pi shehattahor yoshev sham, tahor veeno mekabbel tuma:
Veim amad. hattame, nitma mekom hailan venitma hattahor haover sham:
Vechen beeven hamenuggaat. im adam hannosah over tachat hailan, hattahor haomed sham lo nitma:
Veim hinnichah tame. vehu haddin afillu lo hinnichah, ella sheamad hannosah:
Noten adam maa lechenvani. hammocher yayin, vedar immo bammavoy:

O lenachtom. hammocher kikkarot vedar immo bechatzer, sheyyizke lo baeruv im chaverav, im yavou bene mavoy liknot mimmecha yayin lashshittuf, o bene chatzer liknot kikkar laeruv, sheyyihye li chelek bo:

Lo zachu lo meotav. sheen maot konot ad sheyyimshoch. vaafillu erev ze hachenvani lechol haacherim vezikka gam laze, eno eruv, shehare lo nitkavven lezakkot lo bemattenat chinnam kishar hamezakkin baeruv ella sheyyikne bemaa, vahare enah kona lo, demaot enan konot, venimtza mearev lo bimotav:

Umodim bishar kol adam. baal habbayit sheamar lo chavero helach maa zo vezakke li baeruv vehalach vezikka lo, shekkana eruv, dehoil veen baal habbayit ragil limkor kikkarot lo nitkavven ze ella laasoto shaliach venaasa keomer lo arev li:

Sheen mearvin leadam. keshemmearvin lo mishshello ella middato. hilkach gabbe chenvani ki amar lo zakke li lo nitkavven ella liknot mimmennu velo samach alav sheyyease shelucho, umaot enan konot velo samcheh dateh, nimtza mearev lo shello middato:
Eruve techumin. chov hu, shemmafsid latztzad haacher, veshemma en noach lo. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Ad shello kara alehem. arammi oved avi vegomer. aval leachar shekkara alehem, eno loke im achalan, lefi shehen mamono shel kohen. vezo divre rabbi akiva. aval chachamim omrim, bikkurim hannacha meakkevet bahen, keria en meakkevet bahen, vehaochlan achar hannacha vaazara af al pi sheadayin lo kara alehen eno loke. vahalacha kachachamim. veazharatan middichtiv (Devarim 12) lo tuchal leechol bisharecha maasar degancha vegomer‏ uterumat yadecha, veamar mar, uterumat yadecha ellu habbikkurim, deillu teruma enah teuna havaat makom. uvikkurim nammi eno loke alehen ella im achalan achar sherau fene yerushalayim kodem hannachatan baazara, aval achalan baggevulin kodem sheyyikkansu lirushalayim eno loke:

Kadshe kadashim chutz lakkelaim kadashim kallim chutz lachoma. kol hane azharatan millo tuchal leechol bisharecha vegomer‏ vechol nedarecha asher tiddor. shekkol achila chutz lammakom hakkavua lah mikkere achilat shearecha:

Umaaser sheni. leel tenan maaser sheni tame shello nifda, kidfarshinan, vehacha tenan maaser sheni tahor sheachalo chutz lachoma. vedavka sheachalo chutz lachoma achar sheraa fene yerushalayim hu shelloke, aval haochel maaser sheni vaggevulim kodem sheyyikkanes lirushalayim eno loke, dichtiv (sham) lifne Adonai‏ elohecha tochlennu, veachar kach lo tuchal leechol bisharecha:

Hammotir. eno loke, dichtiv (Shemot 12) lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vehannotar mimmennu ad boker baesh tisrofu, ba hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase, lomar im avarta al lav, kayyem ase shebbah veencha loke. veod, lo totiru have lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav:
Vehashshover. etzem befesach tame eno loke. deamar rachamana (sham) veetzem lo tishberu vo, bakkasher velo vappasul:
Maalim hayu sachar lalviyyim. bearbaim ushetayim ir sheggam hem koltot, maale harotzeach sachar levaal habbayit shehu dar bo:
Rabbi meir omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi meir. vedavka bearbaim ushetayim ir, aval beshesh are miklat kulle alma modu sheen maale sachar levaal habbayit:
Lo haya chozer lasserara shehaya vah. dichtiv (Vayikra 25) veshav el mishpachto veel achuzzat avotav yashuv, lemishpachto hu chozer, veeno chozer lema shehuchzeku avotav. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Ba vesof shavua. achare hittoach habbayit, chozer umasgiro, veim besof shavua chazar hannega, venatatz et habbayit:
Happisyon hassamuch. sheppasa samuch lannega:
Vehachozer kishne gerisim. dichtiv veim yashuv hannega, keadam haomer chazar peloni limkomo, vehannega shebbabbattim battechilla eno metamme ella vishne gerisim, kedaamaran:

Ellu hen hallokin. ellu lav davka, detana veshiyyer lokin tuva. ella tana chayyave cheretot, leashmoinan deyesh malkot bechayyave cheretot. vetana almana ugerusha, leashmoinan almana vehi gerusha chayyavin aleha mishshum shene shemot. vetana tevel umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, delo mipparsha azhara didhu vehedya. vechen hekdesh shello nifda. veayde detana hekdesh, tane maaser sheni, detarvayhu malkot didhu mishshum mechussere fediyya. vechen berubban ikka tzad chiddush:
Netina. min haggivonim hi. umalkot didah millo titchatten bam:
Almana. shennitalmena meish acher, vehi gerusha, chayyav aleha shete malkuyyot:
Mishshum shene shemot. mishshum shete azharot. sheshshetehen meforashot bammikra, veazhara attarvayhu kaamar:

Gerusha. vehi chalutza, eno chayyav aleha mishshum shene shemot. shehachalutza enah ketuva, ella meribbuya maytinan lah, detanya, gerusha, en li ella gerusha, chalutza minnayin, talmud lomar veishsha:
Shello hashshem hamechayyevo malkot. lo hammikra hamechayyevo malkot mechayyevo tashlumin. malkot, millo taane. tashlumin, mivvaasitem lo kaasher zamam:

Kol hameshallem eno loke. dichtiv kede rishato, al risha achat atta mechayyevo vei atta mechayyevo al shete rishayot. umiddekaamre rabbanan meshallem veeno loke velo amre loke veeno meshallem, shema minna dechol hecha deikka tarte malkot vetashlumin lo amrinan yilke velo yeshallem ella meshallem veeno loke. vechen halacha:
Beged hammusgar. shehaya vo nega utzevao veen hannega nikkar bo:
Kullan tehorim. deet havvadday hu metamme, veeno metamme et hassafek:
Vaasao mochin. keraim ketannim pechutim mishshalosh al shalosh, ella shello huvdelu legamre:
Kullan temein. dechevan shennizkak lattuma en hassafek metaharo:
Tame veasur bahanaato. deha serefa vae:
Hannoten eruvo. eruve chatzerot:
Bevet shaar. makom samuch leshaar hechatzer uregilin lehoshiv sham shomer shello yikkansu bene reshut harabbim lechatzer:
Vehaddar sham. bevet shaar shebbechatzer eno oser al baal hechatzer veeno tzarich litten et happat, delav dira hi:
Vehaddar sham oser alav. im hishil baal habbayit bet hatteven shello ladur sham, oser alav, hoil ufatuach lechatzer:

Im yesh sham tefisat yad shel baal habbayit. sheyyesh levaal habbayit makom bedirato shel ze, shennoten sham kelav lehatzenian, eno oser alav. vedavka kesheen sham diyyurin acherim, aval im yesh sham diyyurin acherim oser alehen, dayka nammi dekatane eno oser alav, alav eno oser, aval al diyyurim acherim oser veaf al pi shebbaal habbayit erev immahen. veim hakkelim hallalu shennoten sham baal habbayit hem devarim hannittalim beshabbat, en zo tefisat yad, veoser alav, dei bae shakel lehu veshade lehu avray. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Haav gole al yede veno. keshello hikkahu lelammedo tora o musar o ummanut:
Hakkol golim al yede yisrael. vaafillu eved o chuti:
Chutz meal yede ger toshav. sheim harag ben yisrael beshogeg, eno gole ella neherag:
Hassuma eno gole. dichtiv (Bamidbar la) belo reot, perat lassuma:
Rabbi meir omer gole. belo reot lerabbot et hassuma. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Hassone. kol shello dibber immo shelosha yamim mechamat eva. veen halacha lo cherabbi yose verabbi yehuda velo cherabbi shimon, ella hassone eno neherag veeno niklat, shechezkato shehu karov lemezid:
Nira hannega bashsheti haomed haarig tahor. kesheen atid leerog yoter:
Hashsheti haomed tahor. hayenu ma sheen atid lekatztzetz min hashsheti im haarug:
Hannimin. chutin shebberosh hassadin uvesofo:

Matztzil et haumriyyot. sefat habbeged, sheeno soref oto, dichtiv vesaraf et habbeged batztzemer o vappishtim, sheen talmud lomar batztzemer o vappishtim, ella lelammedcha sheen soref haumriyyot immahen:

Vaafillu hen argaman. delo tema deen matztzil ella cheshehaumriyyot shel min acher sheeno mittame vannegaim kegon shel meshi veshel zahav, kamashma lan vaafillu hen argaman shehu tzemer tzavua matztzil:
Al gabbe shene vattim. vehem bishne tzidde reshut harabbim, metaltelin tachat haaliyya, defi tikra mikkan umikkan yored vesotem:
Vechen gesharim hamefullashim. veyesh lahem mechitztzot millematta bishne hatztzedadim:
Mearvin lemavoy hamefullash. hoil veikka shete mechitztzot, dekasavar mavoy sheyyesh lo shete mechitztzot middeorayta have reshut hayyachid. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Zarak et haeven lirshut harabbim. veaf al gav dekarov lemezid hu, shehaya lo lachshov shebbene adam metzuyim birshut harabbim tamid, hacha askinan beashpa haasuya virshut harabbim lehippanot bah ballayla, veenah asuya lehippanot bah bayyom, vezimnin demikkere deyatev bah, umishshum hachi gole, delav poshea hu velo anus gamur hu:
Vehotzi halla et rosho vekibbelah patur. dichtiv (Devarim 19) umatza et reehu, perat lammamtzi et atzmo:
Im yesh reshut lannizzak. shennatan lo baal habbayit reshut likkanes:
Ma chatavat etzim reshut. dei vae ayel lachtov vei vae lo ayel:
Yatza haav harode et beno. demitzva ka avid:
Sheshshityo tzavua. hashsheti shello tzavua. veen tzavua mittamme:
Veerbo lavan. vei azlinan batar haerev hu lavan umittamme:
Hakkol holech achar hannire. bistam begadim haerev nire, becharim uchesatot hashsheti nire. vehakkol lefi haummanut:
Yerakrak. yarok shebbayrukkim:
Adamdam. adom shebbaadummim. kelomar, shemmare hayyarkut vehaadmimut bahem chazak meod. yerakrak, kichnaf hattavvas uchehutzin shel dekel. adamdam, kizhorit yafa shebbaddam:
Haya yerakrak. kaggeris, velivsof shavua pasa adamdam etzel yerakrak:
Nishtanna ufasa. kegon shehaya vattechilla yerakrak kaggeris, velivsof shavua pasa venaasa gadol kassela, uven haom uven happisyon shello adamdam:
Nishtanna velo fasa. battechilla chaggeris shel yerakrak, velivsof kaggeris shel adamdam:
Keillu lo nishtanna. veoto sheppasa taun serefa, veoto shello fasa masgiro shavua sheni:
Yerae [vattechilla]. dachashiv lenishtanna kenega acher. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Asara vattim. hakkehe varishon. besof shavua rishon kaha, o halach hannega legamre. hare shene vattim, dechishnayim hen chashuvim:
Kolfo. kolef mekom hannega bilvad, vehabbayit tahor:
Hakkehe. besof shavua sheni, vehaholech legamre. shenayim acherim, hare arbaa:
Happose beshavua rishon: choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua. veim chazar, notetz. hare chamishsha:
Lo chazar taun tzipporim. hare shishsha:
Amad. beenav beshavua rishon: ufasa vashsheni, choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua. chazar, notetz. hare shiva:
Lo chazar taun tzipporim. hare shemona:
Amad. beenav beshavua rishon uveshavua sheni: choletz vekotze vetach venoten lo shavua. sheddin haomed beenav beshavua sheni kedin happose. chazar, notetz. hare tisha:
Lo chazar taun tzipporim. hare asara:
Im ad shello tiharo vatztzipporim nira vo nega. hare hu kechozer, vetaun netitza. aval mishshettiharo, have leh kenega chadash umasgiro:
Ad sheyyerae chishne gerisin. dichtiv (sham) veraa et hannega vehinne hannega, melammed sheen nige vattim mittammein, ad sheyyerau kishne gerisin:

O al even echat. vehayenu taama deamar rabbi yishmael arba avanim learbaa chatle habbayit, lechol kotel even echat. ulerabbi akiva deamar ad sheyyerau chishne gerisim al shete avanim lo al even achat, en pachot mishshemone avanim, lechol kotel shete avanim:

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer kulei. taama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon [besanhedrin daf 71] dichtiv kir uchetiv kirot, ezehu kir shehu chekirot, heve omer ze keren zavit, uvechol kir bainan shiur nega, dehaynu kaggeris hakkilki merubba bechol echad veechad. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Matben. gadish shel teven, umafsik al pene kol rochav hachatzerot:

Ellu maachilin. mannichin behemtan leechol min hatteven, velo chayshinan dilma mimit hatteven measara vahava leh chada reshuta veasre ahadade, umetaltele bechatzer velo maske addatayhu, leha lo chayshinan, deha afillu immeit i lo have hammiut al pene eser ammot veyoter lo asre, deha eser ammot pitcha have veen behema memaetet kol kach baachilatah [beshabbat echad]:
Nitmaet hatteven measara tefachim. al pene kol orech hechatzer o bemeshech eser ammot [veod]:
Mearvin echad. im nitmaet bechol lifne hashshabbat:

Eno chayyav ella echat. al ma sheshshata toch kede dibbur shel hateraa. veim haya lefanav keli sheyyesh bo kamma reviiyyot yayin veamru lo al tishte cheli ze sheyyesh bo kach vechach shiurim shettilke kach vechach malkuyyot, chayyav al kol shiur veshiur, af al pi shello hitru vo ella hateraa achat:
Ketovet kaaka. mekarea besakkin al besaro keen otiyyot, veachar kach memalle et hakkeraim deyo o kechol:
Katav. al besaro bidyo o bichchol velo kara besakkin, o kara besakkin velo mille vidyo o bichchol,

Eno chayyav, ad sheyyichtov vikakea. lishna dikra nakat, dichtiv ketovet kaaka, ketiva varesha vahadar kaaka. aval leolam hakkaaka techilla veachar kach hakketav. ukera hachi mashma, uchetovet betoch hakkaaka lo tittenu bachem:

Shekkatuv sham hashshem. baggemara mefaresh deshem avoda zara kaamar. hachi mefaresh lakkera, lo tittenu vachem shem avoda zara, ki ani Adonai‏ velo teshattefu acherim immi. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Deyotaot. aliyyot zo keneged zo vechatzer pechuta mearba ammot lifnehen sheshshofchin bah memehen:
Miktzatan. bene haddeyuta haachat asu uka bechatzer uvene haacheret lo asu:

Veet shello asu uka asurin. kol zeman shello ervu. dei sharet lehu lehane al yede uka dehanach, atu leappoke mane im hashshofchim min habbattim ulehoridan lechatzer behedya ad sefat hauka beraglehem, veka metaltel bechatzer delo ervu bah:
Hare ze oser. dedira belo bealim shemah dira:
Eno oser. delav shemah dira:
Rabbi yose. nammi sevira leh delav shemah dira, mihu nachri oser, shemma yavo beshabbat. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Etzel bitto. davka bitto, deaved eynash dedayyar im chatano, aval beno en adam massiach dato mibbeto ladur etzel beno, shemma titkotet kallato immo veyetze. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Haeven shebbazzavit. shehi veno uven chavero beshuttafut:
Choletz et kullo. kiddarshinan vechilletzu, melammed sheshshenehem choltzim:
Bizman shehu notetz. et habbayit kullo:
Notetz shello. degabbe netitza ketiv et avanav veet etzav, avanav shello veetzav shello:

Rosh ufittin. peresh hearuch, otah haeven o oto haetz shettofes mitztzad maarav nidbach shello, uletzad mizrach nidbach shel chavero, shem otah haeven o oto haetz, rosh. veotam haavanim veetzim shebbenidbach ze bammaarav achat, uvenidbach ze bammizrach achat, sheman pittin:
Haomed. beeno besof shavua rishon, shello fasa velo chaha marito:
Yechabbes. mekom hannega veyasgir:
Haomed bashsheni. besof shavua sheni lo chaha velo fasa:
Happose vaze uvaze. besof shavua rishon o besof shavua sheni:
Hichha vattechilla. keshehuva el hakkohen veraahu vekodem shehisgir kaha:
Yechabbes veyasgir. keillu chaha vesof shavua rishon:
Hichha. shehaya mittechilla chazak hayyarkut o haadmimut, venaasa yarok benoni o adom benoni:
Eno zakuk lo. en zakuk lehasegiro, vetahor. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hichha varishon yechabbes veyasgir. keillu lo chaha:
Hichha vashsheni. divsof shavua sheni metzao shekkaha:
Koro vesoref ma shekkara, vetzarich matlit. leshon telay, chatichat beged bimkom hakkera, dichtiv veim terae od, veen od ella mekomo, melammed shehu tole alav matlit:
Rabbi nechemya omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi nechemya:
Habbone min hammusgar betahor. leachar shechalatz vekatza vetach venatan lo shavua, betoch yeme hesgero lakach meoto vayit avanim uvenaan bevayit acher:
Chazar nega labbayit. hammusgar:
Choletz et haavanim. shellakach mimmennu umesallekan min hattahor, vehen temeim ketumat habbayit shennetalan mimmennu:
Chazar hannega laavanim. shennivna vetahor:

Habbayit. hammusgar yinnatetz, keillu hayu kevuim bo. vehane avanim nammi bau netitza, ella shemmamtin lahem ad sheyyeshammeshu habbayit hashsheni besimanin, detaun hesger, vedino lechol davar kechol bayit shennira vo nega battechilla:
Kol habbattim. vedavka veeretz yisrael, divvet eretz achuzzatchem ketiv (Vayikra 14):

Chutz mishshel nachrim. im kanu vayit beeretz yisrael. dehachi mashma, achuzzatchem mittammea vannegaim, veen achuzzat hannachrim mittammea vannegaim. ucheshem sheen achuzzatam mittammea vannegaim, kach bigdehem vegufam en mittammeim bannegaim:
Yerau vattechilla. vehayyamim shehaya vahem hannega kol zeman shehayu veyad nachrim, enam olim lahen min hacheshbon:
Bayit agol. sheen bo zaviyyot:
Terigon. sheyyesh lo shalosh zaviyyot. shalosh bilshon romi 219. vehu haddin bayit sheyyesh lo shete zaviyyot o chamesh:
Eno mittamme vannegaim. degabbe negaim ketiv kirot kirot shete feamim, umiut kirot shenayim, hare arbaa:
Uveaskarya. hu toren hassefina. veyesh sefarim sheggorsim achsadya, vehen korot shekkoshrim beyachad umolichin otan banneharot uvayyam. uvilshon mikra keruyin rafsodot:
Enan mittammein bannegaim. dichtiv bevet eretz, ad sheyyihye habbayit mechubbar baaretz:
Al arba korot. kemo o al arba korot. shehaya habbayit banuy al gabbe hakkorot:
Afillu al arbaa ammudim. shehaammudim mechubbarim baaretz vehen nechshavim arba zaviyyot labbayit vehaggag alehen, mittamme vannegaim af al pi shehu fatuach mikkol tzedadav:
Gezuztera. keen daf o makom mekore hayyotze mershut hayyachid uvolet al gabbe hammayim:
Ella im ken asu mechitztza. kol sevivot haggezuzetra o seviv nekev arbaa al arbaa hechakuk beemtzeitah, deamrinan gud achit mechitztzata:
Ben milmala. lemala min nekev haggezuzetra:

Ben millematta. mechubberet laggezuztera mittachteha. verambam peresh millematta al hammayim keneged nekev haggezuzetra, deamrinan gud assik keillu higgia hammechitztza lannekev shebbaggezuztera shemmemallein mimmennu:
Zo lemala mizzo. venekev shemmemallein mimmennu baelyona mechuvvan keneged nekev hattachtona:
Asu laelyona. shennishtattefu bene hattachtona im bene haelyona laasot mechitztza baelyona velo asu battachtona:

Shetehen asurot ad sheyyearevu. shekkevan shebbene hattachtona shuttafin bimchitztza zo shel elyona osrin alehem. veim asu lattachtona velo asu laelyona af al pi sheen laelyona shuttafut bammechitztza shel tachtona shetehen asurot. haelyona asura shehare en lah mechitztza, vehattachtona hoil veyesh derech laelyona aleha sheggam hi memallet mayim mishsham oseret aleha ad sheyyearvu immah. vehane mille kesheshshete haggezuzetraot muflagot zo mizzo, sheyyesh gavoah asara tefachim o yoter ben zo lezo, aval im shetehen betoch asara, afillu asu shetehen mechitztza leolam osrot zo al zo ad sheyyearvu:

Bakkol mearvin. eruve techumin, deillu eruve chatzerot en mearvin ella befat. umihu bakkol mearvin deamar rabbi eliezer hacha, laatoye eruve chatzerot shemmearvin befat perusa veen tzarich kikkar shelema, ufaleg aleh rabbi yehoshua veamar davka kikkar shalem hu eruv. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
En mearvin bah. vetaama mishshum eva, shebbaim bene hechatzer lide machaloket lomar ani noten shelema vehu noten perusa:

Kikkar beissar vehu shalem mearvin bo. notnin oto baeruv im shear kikkarot shel bene chatzer, uvilvad sheyyihye ben kullam kigrogeret lechol echad veechad. verambam peresh dechikkar shalem keissar mearvin bo levaddo lechol bene hechatzer veen tzarich shiur:
Nigmar dino belo chohen gadol. shello haya kohen gadol baolam:
Lo leedut mitzva. kegon leedut hachodesh:

Vechol adam. chutz miggoel haddam sheharago chutz leir miklato, eno chayyav alav, dichtiv (sham) en lo dam, vegoel haddam reshut beyado lehargo. vahalacha kerabbi akiva. vehane mille, sheyyatza mezid. aval yatza shogeg, kol adam sheharago neherag alav:

Hakkol holech achar hannof. baggemara mefaresh deaf achar hannof kaamar, sheim haya ikkaro betoch hattechum shel are miklat venofo note chutz lattechum, kevan shennichnas tachat nofo, niklat, hoil veikkaro lifnim shadinan nofo batar ikkaro. vei ikkaro vachutz venofo bifnim, ki hechi divnofo lo matze katel leh, beikkaro nammi lo matze katel leh, deshadena ikkaro vatar nofo lechumra:

En shofchin letochah mayim beshabbat. divarba ammot, hammayim sheadam asuy lehishtammesh bahen bechol yom nivlaim sham bimkomam veen yotzin lirshut harabbim, pachot mearba ammot, en nivlaim bimkomam veyotzin lirshut harabbim:
Uka. gumma:
Machazeket satayim. mippene shehaadam asuy lehistappek satayim mayim bechol yom:
Min hannekev ulematta. sheyyihye hechalal shel hauka machazik satayim kodem sheyyaggiu hammayim el hannekev sheal sefatah shebbo mekallechin lirshut harabbim:
Ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz. ben sheasa hauka bechatzer ben sheasaah birshut harabbim:
Tzarich likmor. laasot aleha kemin kippa mechussa millemala kede shettehe chaluka mershut harabbim:
Shetterafan. sheervan veasa mehen beged:
Im rov min haggemallim vechulei. shehatztzemer shel rechelim mitbattel berov:
Mechetza lemechetza. shetztzemer gemallim ketzemer rechelim beshave:
Vechen happishtan vehakkanbos shetterafan ze vaze. veasa mehen beged, dinan kedin tzemer gemallim vetzemer rechelim shetterafan:
Hashsheti vehaerev. shel tzemer, shennikkar ben sheti leerev, shehashsheti dak vehaerev av meod:

Hashsheti mishsheyyishshalek. dichtiv beveged tzemer o beveged pishtim o vishti o veerev, ma beged shennigmera melachto, af sheti vaerev mishshettiggamer melachtan. vetanna kamma savar, o vishti, hifsik hainyan:
Mishsheyyishshalek. bemayim rotchim. veyesh sefarim sheggorsim mishsheyyishshale, kelomar mishsheyyihyu sholin umesirim oto min hayyora sheshsholkim otan bah lelabbenan:
Haunin shel pishtan. aguddot matve shel pishtan. ulefi shebbappishtan en nikkar ben sheti laerev kemo vatztzemer, mishshum hachi lo mefalleg behu ben sheti leerev:
Mishsheyyitlabbenu. shennotnim otan battannur sheyyitchammemu vehevel hattannur veyitlabbenu sham:
Pekaat. etz shehannashim mesabbevot hammatve min hakkush letocho:

Kede leerog mimmenna shalosh al shalosh. sheyyehe vah shiur laasot kol habbeged shel shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot mimmenna, gam hashsheti gam haerev, kidkatane vaafillu chullah sheti vaafillu chullah erev:
Hayta fesikot. shehayu hachutim shebbappekaat mufsakin, lo have chibbur. aval im hayu keshurim have chibbur:
Afillu fesika achat. sheen bechol happekaat ella fesika achat ukesharah, lo have chibbur. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Etzim. kidamrinan sheen habbayit mittamme ad sheyyihyu vo etzim, kamma yihyu vechol kotel vechotel, kede litten tachat hashshekof. kach tzarich lechol kir vekir:
Shekof. makom shehaddelet shokef alav, uregilin litten etz tachtav:
Sandal laachore hashshekof. regilim lehanniach etz laachore hashshekof lehagen, venikra sandal, kemo shehassandal megen al haregel. shekof, nikra ben shel petach ben shel challon:
Patztzim. leshon sedek vekera. kemo (tehillim 60) hirashta eretz petzamtah:
Kirot haevus. shel behema:
Vekirot hammechitztza. shel (chatzerot) gannot ufardesim:
En mittammein bannegaim. dichtiv bekirot habbayit, velo bekirot haevus velo bekirot hammechitztza:
Yerushalayim vechutza laaretz enan mittammein bannegaim. dichtiv (Vayikra 14) bevet eretz achuzzatchem, vechutza laaretz enah achuzzatchem, virushalayim nammi lo nitchalleka lashshevatim:
Mezon shete seudot lechol echad. mittoch shekkone shevitato sham tzarich lehanniach sham mazon shetztzarich lo leshabbat:

Ellu vaellu mitkavvenim lehakel. rabbi meir savar beshabbat achil eynash tefe mishshum devasim tavshileh. verabbi yehuda savar kevan divshabbat achil shalosh seudot eno marbe leechol bechol seuda, ushete seudot shel chol have tefe mishshete seudot shel shabbat:

Kikkar befundeyon. kikkar hallakuach befundeyon keshemmochrin arbaa sein chittin lesela. vearbaa sein hen esrim vearbaa kabbin, vehassela esrim vearbaa main, nimtza kav lechol maa, vehammaa shene fundeyonin, hare kikkar hannimkar bashshuk befundeyon hu chatzi kav, vehachenvani lokeach hachetzi lischar haafiyya vehattechina, nimtza kikkar hallakuach min hachenvani befundeyon hu reva kav shehem shesh betzim, shehakkav esrim vearba betzim, vehem shiur shete seudot shel eruv ledivre rabbi yochanan ben beroka. vahalacha kemoto:

Rabbi shimon. memaet bashshiur veomer shedday learev bishte yadot shel kikkar shel shelosha kikkarot lekav. vechikkar shalem shel shemone betzim hu shelishit hakkav. ushete yedoteha shehem chamesh betzim veyoter havu shete seudot:

Chetzyah levayit hamenugga. setam matnitin hi, vehachi kaamar, chatzi kikkar shalem sheshshiaru bo ben lemar uven lemar, hu shiur lishhiyyat bayit hamenugga, shehannichnas levayit sheyyesh bo nega tzaraat af al pi shehu tame miyyad eno taun kibbus begadim ad sheyyishhe kede achila, vachatzi kikkar zo have kede achila. ulerabbi yochanan ben beroka deamar kikkar shalem have reva kav shehem shishsha betzim, nimtza chetzyah shalosh betzim, vehu peras divchulle talmuda. ulerabbi shimon deamar kikkar shalem hu shel shelishit hakkav shehem shemone betzim, have chetzyah arba betzim, vehu peras divchulle talmuda allibba derabbi shimon. veaf al gav derabbi shimon savar divchikkar shalem yesh shalosh seudot, deha shete yedoteha kaamar rabbi shimon dahave shete seudot, hane mille beeruv denitkavvenu bo lehakel veen tzarich shete seudot shelemot, aval bechol shear duchete sevira leh lerabbi shimon deen seuda pechuta mechatzi kikkar shel shelishit hakkav, uvainan sheyyishhe kede achilat chatzi kikkar zo shehem arba betzim:

Chatzi chetzyah lifsol et haggeviyya. dehaochel ochalim temeim kachatzi peras nifsal gufo midderabbanan milleechol bitruma. vachatzi peras have betza umechetza lerabbi yochanan ben beroka, ushete betzim lerabbi shimon:
Bamme devarim amurim bedine nefashot. dichtiv (Bamidbar la) vehitztzilu haeda, umehadderinan azzechuta:
Echad dine mamonot. nammi edutan betela:

Bizman shehitru vahen. bedine nefashot ayre. kelomar, ki amrinan divtela, zehu bizman shehakkarov o happasul nishtattef mittechilla lihyot min hammatrin beovre avera, aval im lo hitru vahen velo chivven lihyot ed baddavar, lo vetela edut haacherim bishvil reiyyato shel ze. vahalacha kerabbi:
Chazar nega labbeged. bemakom acher min habbeged, velo vammatlit shennatan al mekom hakkeria:

Matztzil et hammatlit. keshessoref et habbeged kullo. kedichtiv veim terae od babbeged vegomer‏ vesaraf et habbeged. matztzil et hammatlit, oto telay shennatan al mekom hakkeria matztzilo, veeno sorfo im habbeged:
Chazar lammatlit. leoto telay shechibber bo:

Soref et habbaged. keillu chazar babbeged atzmo. aval hammatlit eno taun serefa, ella im hu shalosh al shalosh, masgiro. veim amad beenav shavuot shenayim o fasa beshavua rishon, soref. veim pachot mishshalosh al shalosh, eno mittamme vannegaim:

Hattole min hammusgar. sheasa telay mechatichat beged musgar al beged tahor. umusgar kare leveged sheamad beenav beshavua rishon, uveshavua sheni kaha, dekorea mimmennu hannega vesoref ma shekkara, ushear habbeged karuy musgar:
Chazar hannega labbeged. hammusgar. shennittela mimmennu chaticha zo shehi atta telay leveged tahor, af al pi shehabbeged hammusgar taun serefa kedichtiv veim terae od babbeged vegomer:
Matztzil et hammatlit. hayenu hattelay hazze shennittal mimmennu umechubbar beveged tahor, matztzilo veeno sorfo im habbeged hammusgar:
Chazar. hannega:
Lammatlit. lachaticha zo shennittela min hammusgar:

Yissaref. hammusgar bechol makom shehu, keillu hayta chaticha zo mechubberet bo. vachaticha teshammesh habbeged hashsheni shehi mechubberet bo: besimanim. shemmasgir im habbeged hashsheni. dedino shel sheni keillu hannega bo, ben leinyan hesger ben leinyan serefa vechibbus vechol davar. uleachar sheshshimmesha habbeged hashsheni, afillu halach hannega legamre min hachaticha, taun serefa, shehare mishshechazar bo hannega mittechillato kevar huzkak lisrefa:
Hamefattem et hashshemen. haose shemen dugmat shemen hammishcha:
Vehassach beshemen hammishcha. sheasa moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom:
Achal tevel. azharateh millo yechallelu et kadshe bene yisrael et asher yarimu (Vayikra 22), baatidin litrom hakkatuv medabber:
Umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato. sheaf hu vemita ketevel, dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) venechshav lachem terumatchem kaddagan min haggoren vegomer‏:

Umaaser sheni shello nifda. maaser sheni shennitma vaafillu hu virushalayim asur leachlo ad sheyyippade, vehaochlo virushalayim ad shello nifda loke. veazharato mivvelo viarti mimmennu betame (Devarim 26), ben sheani tame vehu tahor ben sheani tahor vehu tame. uminnayin lemaaser sheni shennitma sheppodin oto virushalayim, shenneemar (sham 14) ki lo tuchal seeto, perush, lo tuchal leachlo, kedichtiv (Bereshit 43) vayyissa masot meet panav:
Vehekdesh shello nifda. lo chetiv beh lav behedya, ella atya azhara dideh gezera shava dechet chet mitteruma. veaf al gav demiet rachamana umetu vo, velo vimila, mimmita miateh velo meazhara:
Beochel nemala shehu chayyav. mishshum sheretz hashshoretz al haaretz (Vayikra 11), veaf al gav delet bah kashshiur:
Af chitta achat kivriyyatah. velet hilchata kerabbi shimon. delo karinan beriyya ella livriyya sheyyesh lah neshama vilvad:
Lo yigzor. lo yifsok haddayyan lomar shehu nega vadday, middichtiv kenega nira li babbayit, velo chetiv nega:

Afillu chavile etzim. sheenan bichlal tuma, tzarich lefannot. veha dichtiv velo yitma kol asher babbayit, demashma deattuma kafed rachamana, sevira leh lerabbi yehuda demilleta veanpe nafsha hi, leashmoinan dechelim dahavu meikkara nammi mittammu i shavek lehu. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Esek ze lappinnuy. bitmiyya, vechi lehaasiko lefannot et habbayit hutzrach hakkatuv, sheatta mazkiko lefannot devarim sheen mekabbelim tuma, al karchach lo va hakkatuv lidrosh ella kemo sheddoresh rabbi meir shehattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael:
Pakko. leshon pakkim ketannim:

Tifyo. makom sheofe umevashshel bo kederato, kegon tannur vechirayim shel cheres hammittaltelin. veyesh sefarim sheggorsim tifyo betet, vehu keli cheres katan meod sheen hammashke yotze hemennu ella tif tif. vechol ellu en lahem tohora vemikve:
Im kach al shel rasha. shehannegaim baim al lashon hara:
Ziz. even o etz habbolet min hakkotel al avir reshut harabbim, gavoah asara tefachim mehakkarka shel reshut harabbim:

Notnin alav. bene aliyya, venotlim mimmennu, sheavir reshut harabbim enah holechet ella ad asara. vedavka kelim hannishbarim kegon kosot utzelochiyyot hu denotnim alav, aval kelim sheenam nishbarim lo, dilma naflu birshut harabbim veate leatoyinhu:

Omed adam birshut hayyachid. babbayit o al haggag, venotel chefetz kan umanniach kan birshut harabbim, veaf al pi sheen rosho verubbo omed birshut harabbim bimkom hachefetz, velo gazrinan shemma yeviennu etzlo:
Uvilvad shello yotziennu. mearba ammotav shehaya munnach bo:

Ad sheyyazomu atzman. sheyyazomu otan beiske gufan, lo veiske hahoreg [veheharug], kedimfaresh veazel. venafka lan mikkera dichtiv (Devarim 19) vehinne ed sheker haed, ad sheyyihye hashsheker begufan shel edim:

Kol habbegadim. laatoye begadim shel avadim venashim uketannim, vaafillu shel ger toshav. uvilvad shehen mitztzemer ufishtim, kedichtiv (Vayikra 13) beveged tzemer o beveged pishtim, begadim shel tzemer ufishtim in, begadim shel midi acharina lo:

Yerau vattechilla. afillu venega shehaya vahem kodem shebbau lide yisrael. dehay beged hava chazi lingaim, ella shershuto shel nachri hayta meakkevet, hilkach yamim shehaya vahen hannega beodo virshut hannachri enan olim lo min hamminyan, umishshebba lirshut yisrael yerae vattechilla:
Veorot hayyam enan mittammein. dichtiv (Vayikra 13) lappishtim velatztzamer o veor, ma tzemer ufishtim min haggadel baaretz, af or mimmin haggadel baaretz:
Chibber lahen. leorot shel dagim haggedelim min hayyam:
Min haggadel baaretz afillu chut afillu meshicha. uvilvad sheyyechabberennu lo kederech chibburo, bishte techifot o yoter:
Bor shebben shete chatzerot. chetzyo baze vechetzyo baze, en memallein mimmennu, shezze memalle mershut chavero veasur im lo ervu hachatzerot zo im zo:
Ben milmala. shehayu tisha tefachim shel mechitztza lemala min hammayim vetefach echad meshukka bammayim:
Ben millematta. shehaya tisha tefachim meshukkaim betoch hammayim vetefach echad nire lemala:

Ben mittoch ogno. af al pi sheen hammechitztza nogaat bammayim kelal, dekulla hi shehekellu chachamim bemayim deamrinan gud achit mechitztzata, uvilvad shettehe betoch ogen habbor, shetterae kehafesaka:
Min hakkotel shebbenehem. shemmafseket ben hachatzerot umafseket al pene habbor, veaf al pi sheenah nichneset toch agno. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Vehu foshet velovesh. velo foshet legamre, ella kevan shehotzi rosho vehechziro chayyav. uvaggemara kaamar deeno foshet mammash, ella sheshshaha ven hateraa lehateraa kede lifshot velilbosh, have chefoshet vechozer velovesh vechayyav al kol hateraa vehateraa:

Mishshum lo taane. shehare keshei efshar lekayyem baedim vaasitem lo kaasher zamam, kegon meidim anu veish peloni shehu ven gerusha, lokim haedim mishshum lo taane, hacha deikka azharat lo taane veikka nammi kaasher zamam, lokim shemonim. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Meshalleshin bemamon. edim zommin shechayyavin betashlumin meshallemin hammamon lefi mispar haedim. im hayu shelosha edim vehuzammu, kol echad meshallem shelish hammamon shehayu rotzim lehafesido:

Veen meshalleshin bemakkot. sheen kol echad mehaedim loke shelish malkot, ella kol echad loke arbaim. devainan vaasitem lo kaasher zamam, vechol echad mehem mevakkesh lehalekot hanniddon malkot shalem. umamon mitztaref, kesheyyitten kol echad mehem shelish hare kibbel ma sheratzu lehafesido ben kullam, aval makkot lo mitztarfin:
Ellu hen haggolin. haya meaggel bemagila. even chalaka agulla shemmeaggelin otah al gabbe hassid o hattit shebbaaliyya lehashevot hassedakim:
Haya meshalshel bechavit. milmala lematta:
Aval im haya moshech bemagila. mimmatta lemala:
Kol shebbederech yeridato gole. dichtiv (Bamidbar la) vayyappel alav, ad sheyyehe derech nefila. vechol, laatoye afillu yerida shehi letzorech aliyya:
Nishmat habbarzel mikkatto. mibbet yad shehu takua bo:

Rabbi omer eno gole. rabbi savar venashal habbarzel min haetz ze etz hammitbakkea, velo etzo shehu takua bo. verabbanan savre min haetz, meetzo shehu takua bo. vahalacha kachachamim. deetz hammitbakkea koach kocho hu, veal yede choach kocho eno gole:

Umechuvvanot hayu lahen hadderachim. shehayu osim hadderachim sheyyehu mechuvvanot leare miklat shello yehe harotzeach toe vadderech. umiklat miklat haya chatuv al parashat derachim, kede sheyyakkir harotzeach veyifne lesham:
Vidabberu elav. medabberim legoel haddam al tinhag minhag shel shofche damim, bishgaga va maase ze leyado:
Hu medabber al yede atzmo. en talmide chachamim nizkakin ledabber legoel haddam baavuro, ella hu toen taanot leatzmo. veen halacha kerabbi meir:

Haggadol muttar. lehotzi lo kele bayit shellematta, veen bene hakkatan osrin alav. dilgabbe gadol hach pirtza pitcha hi veshare beotan gippufim haodfim meat mikkan umeat mikkan kemaake shesseviv haggaggot, vachashiva setima, uchegon sheen happirtza yoter meeser. aval katan asur lehotzi lo kele habbayit, divne gadol asre aleh, shehare nifratz lo bimloo:
Haggedola mutteret. bishvil haggippufin shennisharu lah mikkan umikkan have hach pirtza kefetach:

Vehakketanna asura. shehare nifretza bimloah. vedavka keshennifretza kodem hashshabbat, aval im nifretza beshabbat afillu hakketanna mutteret, shekkevan shehuttera lemiktzat shabbat kodem shennifretza huttera lechullah shabbat:
Chatzer shennifretza lirshut harabbim. shennafal hakkotel happone lirshut harabbim bimloo o beyoter meeser:
Chayyav. dechirshut harabbim hi:
Patur. aval asur, delav reshut harabbim hi ella karmelit. vahalacha kachachamim:
Merubbin. shemona asar bene adam ulemala:
Muatin. pachot mishshemona asar:
Mezon shete seudot. hen shemone esre gerogarot:
Lehotzaat shabbat. shiur shel hotzaat shabbat. ki hammotzi ochalim beshabbat eno chayyav befachot mikkigrogeret:
Uminnayin afillu mea. sheshshenayim mazzimin mea sheheidu yachad:
Ma shenayim enan neheragin ad shehuzammu shenehen. dichtiv (Devarim 19) vehinne ed sheker haed, veamar mar, kol makom shenneemar ed hare chan shenayim ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv echad:
Ad sheyyihyu shelashtan zommin. vehu sheheid kol echad betoch kede dibbur shel siyyumo shel chavero. aval im heidu shenayim uleachar zeman heidu haacherim, hare hen shete chittot lechol davar:
Rabbi akiva omer lo va hashshelishi ella lehachemir alav. shello tomar hoil uvelo hashshelishi hayta haedut mitkayyemet lo yaasu vo din hazamma, limmedcha hakkatuv sheaf hu niddon:
Al achat kamma vechamma. shemmidda tova merubba al middat puranut:
