Lehechan golin leare miklat. vearbaim ushetayim ir shel leviyyim nammi kullan koltot. ella sheellu shesh are miklat ben nichnas sham rotzeach ledaat shettikletennu uven nichnas shello ledaat, koltot. ushetayim vearbaim ir, ledaat koltot, shello ledaat enan koltot, veim harago goel haddam lesham, patur:
Noten et hakkorot laaliyya. vesomchan baammudin veeno nottzan im habbayit, dichtiv et avanav veet etzav veet [kol] afar habbayit, velo avanim veetzim veafar shel aliyya:

Nittatzin immo. dedarshinan et avanav veet etzav veet afar habbayit, kol avanim shennivnu immo vechol etzim shennivnu immo vechol afar shennivna immo. vechevan deen aliyya al gabbav, hare chullam nivnu immo:
Malbenim. kemin levenim merubbaot sheshshotchim al haggaggot. veyesh mefarshim, keen mezuzot sheosim bachallonot mibbachutz lenoy, veen mechubbarim betit bachallon:
Serigot. kemin sevacha sheosim bachallon shemmistakkelim mishsham lirshut harabbim:
Malben. etz aroch sheal hakkir heasuy lehoshiv alav rashe hakkorot shello yerakvu millachluchit hachoma:
Bechazzayit. mishshum detzaraat ittakkash lemet, dichtiv (Bamidbar 12) al na tehi kammet:
Bemashshehu. keevarim shel met, ditnan beohalot, haevarim en lahem shiur. veen halacha kerabbi elazar:
Hammotze tefillin. bassade bemakom sheenan mishtammerim:

Zug zug. echad barosh veechad bazzeroa kederech shellovesh bachol, vehayenu zug, vechozer tamid umachnis zug zug ad sheyyachnis et kullan. kasavar shabbat zeman tefillin hu, ella shechachamim gazru alehen gezera shemma tippasek retzua viviem beyado, veim yilbash yoter mizzug ikka bal tosif veate issur bal tosif umashve lehu aleh kemasseoy, verabban gamliel savar shabbat lav zeman tefillin hu, vehayenu taama desharu leh rabbanan behatztzala mishshum detachshit hu, hilkach machnisan shene zugot shene zugot, dishne zugot have tachshit, lefi sheshshaninu makom yesh barosh lehaniach bo shene tefillin, vechol kamma dahave tachshit share. umishshum bal tosif lekka hacha, deen kan mitzvat tefillin kelal ella kishar malbush dealma, veen halacha kerabban gamliel:

Bishanot. shennikkar hakkesher, devadday tefillin hen veyesh bahen kedushsha, veasur lehannichan bimkom bizzayon. aval bachadashot en mechallelin shabbat alehen lehachenisan, dilma kamea bealma ninhu, veen kedushsha ella baasuyin kehilchatan lishman:
Tzevutim. keshurim kol zug zug leatzmo:
Keruchim. harebe beyachad:

Machshich alehen. yoshev umeshammeram sham ad shettechshach, umishshechashecha machnisan kullam beyachad. uchegon shehem merubbim, sheim yeviem zug zug lo tichle havaatan kodem hallayla, sheim hem beinyan shettichle hachenasatan labbayit kodem hallayla machnisan zug zug kidamran:

Uvesakkana. sheggazru shemad shello lehaniach tefillin. umatnitin chassore mechasra vehachi katane, bamme devarim amurim, besakkana shel shemad, aval im mityare lishhot sham mippene hallistim, molichan pachot pachot mearba ammot:
Nitmaet haochel. mishshiuro hameforash lekamman bematnitin:

Mosif umezakke. im ba lehosif mishshello afillu mimmin acher sheeno mimmin hashshittuf harishon, mosif umezakke veeno tzarich lehodian, kevan shennishar ketzat min hammin harishon eno nire kimarev battechilla. aval im noten mimmin hashshittuf harishon, afillu kala legamre mevi meoto hammin umezakke veeno tzarich lehodian:

Nittosfu alehem diyyurim mosif umezakke vetzarich lehodia. vedavka bizman sheyyesh lechatzer shene petachim lishte mevoot, shekkesheose eruv im anshe mavoy ze asur lehishtammesh bemavoy acher, lefichach tzarich lehodia, dilma lo nicha lehu liknot beruach zo ulehanniach yad baruach shekkenegdah. aval im en lo petach ella lemavoy ze shennishtattefu bo techilla eno tzarich lehodia, dezachin laadam shello befanav veen chavin laadam ella befanav:

Mishshete ruchoteha. meruach achat shettofeset shete ruchoteha, kegon shennifretza bekeren zavit, afillu en bappirtza eser ammot, hacha bekeren zavit lo chashev kefetach, defitcha bekeren zavit lo avde eynashe. ufirtza beyoter meeser afillu meruach achat oseret:

Vechen bayit shennifratz mishshete ruchotav. shennifratz bekeren zavit venafal ketzat mikkotel ze uketzat mikkotel ze, veen hattikra perusa umetucha al mekom happirtza, aval im hattikra perusa al mekom happirtza en happirtza oseret babbayit, deamrinan pi tikra yored vesotem:
Muttarin leotah shabbat. hoil vehuttar miktzato:
Leatid lavo. lashshabbat habbaa:

Rabbi yose omer im muttarin kulei. kelomar keshem sheasurin leatid lavo kach asurin leotah shabbat. vahalacha kerabbi yose, velo amrinan huttera miktzat shabbat huttera kullah ella leinyan eruv, sheddavar shehuttar al yede eruv lemiktzat shabbat, venolad beotah shabbat davar shehaya rauy sheal yado yitbattel haeruv, en haeruv batel, shekkevan shehuttera miktzat shabbat huttera kullah, aval makom shehayu bo mechitztzot kodem hashshabbat venifretzu mechitztzotav beshabbat lo amrinan beh hoil vehuttera miktzat shabbat huttera kullah:

Hakkoreach karcha. mishshum demichayyav al kol karcha vekarcha veal kol serita userita veal kol pea ufea, ma sheen ken beochel chelev vechelev, mishshum hachi teninhu vematnitin. aval shear lave gerede sheen bahen chiddush lo tana:

Karcha. al met. kedichtiv (Devarim 14) velo tasimu karcha ben enechem lamet. veaf al gav degabbe chohanim lo chetiv al met, kevar lamdu vigzera shava mikkarcha karcha, ma beyisrael al met, af bechohanim al met. veshiur karcha chigris:

Hammakkif et rosho. mashve tzedaav laachore azno ufaddachto. vaafillu al gilluach shebbemisparayim sheen bo hashechata chayyav al peat harosh, dedavka vezakan ketiv hashechata veenah ella betaar, aval bifat harosh hakkafa chetiv, bechol inyan shehu makkif chayyav:

Serita achat al chamishsha metim o chamesh seritot al met echad. dichtiv (Vayikra 19) veseret lanefesh lo tittenu, lechayyev al kol serita userita veal kol nefesh venefesh, veaf al gav shello hayta sham ella hateraa achat vehayu chol chamesh seritot bevat achat, chayyav:
Al harosh shetayim. achat al yamin veachat al semol:

Veal hazzakan shetayim mikkan ushetayim mikkan. mekom chibbur hassanter laetzem, achat mimin hassanter veachat missemolo, veshibbolet hazzakan baemtza, hare shalosh, vechibbur hatztzedaayim mikkan umikkan hare chamesh. lechi haelyon hamechubbar latztzedaayim velechi hattachton shebbayyamin, velechi haelyon vehattachton shebbassemol, hare shetayim mikkan ushetayim mikkan, vesof hazzakan shehassear yotze mimmennu keen shibbolet, lefichach nikra shibbolet hazzakan, hare ze chamesh:
Eno chayyav ella echat. dechevan delav echad hu, hare hu keochel shene zetim shel chelev behateraa achat:
Ad sheyyittelennu vetaar. appeat zakan kae, dichtiv beh gilluach vehashechata:
Malket. keli heasuy keen melkachayim, lilkot et hassear:
Rehitni. hu maatzad bilshon mikra. keli shebbo machalik charash etzim pene halluach. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Hammaale min happekaat lachavertah. peamim shehannashim osot pekaat bat amma o bat shete ammot umegalgelot umesabbevot mizzo lazo laasot pekaat gedola, veim ad shello taale et kullah nira nega beachat mehen vechut mechabberan, have hashsheni tahor:
Selil. etz chalul kemin kane shemmechabberim alav hammatve:
Koved haelyona. shene etzim agullim shehaorgin korchim bahen hashsheti shellahen vegollin, venira nega bakkoved haechad,
Hashsheni tahor. delo have chibbur:

Vechen shene dappe chaluk. nammi enan chibbur. velo cheen chalukim shellanu shemmechattechim umechabberin bo vatte hazzeroa ushear chatichot bitfira shel chibbur gamur, dehahu vadday chashiv chibbur keillu hu veged echad, ella mayre delo michabbar kulle hay:

Benefesh hammassechet. chut haerev shennichnas letoch hashsheti kannefesh letoch hagguf, vead sheyyityashshevu al mechonam etzel haarug have chishti lehitztaref immo lenega kaggeris. i nammi, battechilla kesheoreg bo shene vatte nirim kodem sheyyeerog bo shalosh al shalosh:

Uvashsheti haomed. hem chute hashsheti shebben koved haelyon lattachton, sheomdim sham leareg ulehasech bahen chute haerev. veka mashma lan delo tema kol chut vechut omed bifne atzmo veen bo rochav kaggeris, ella chullam chibbur ze laze, veim nira (nammi) nega betzad ze, tame betzad acher:

Im haya ratzuf. shehachutim retzufim ze etzel ze keen ritzpa, sheorgin ze etzel ze, shekken derech haorgim leyashshevan lihyot arigatam mechuvvenet, az chashiva chibbur. vei lav hachi, chazinan kol chut keillu omed bifne atzmo velo have chibbur. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Kol gaggot hair reshut achat. veaf al pi sheddiyyurim chalukim lematta lishne bene adam, mikkol makom haggaggot sheen tashmishan tadir en bahen chalukkat reshut, vechelim sheshshavtu begag ze muttar lehotzian laze:

Uvilvad shello yehe gag gavoah mechavero asara. deim chaluk mehen begova asara asur letaltel mimmennu laggaggin, gezera mishshum tel gavoah asara verachav arbaa birshut harabbim, delo lete lechattef alav:
Kol echad reshut leatzmo. veim lo ervu diyyurim shellematta asur letaltel mizze laze:

Rabbi shimon. mekel mikkullan vekaamar, gaggot vachatzerot vekarpefot sheenan yoter mibbet satayim, hoil vechullan en tashmishan meyuchad vetadir, reshut achat hen umetaltelin mizze laze belo eruv, vaafillu hayu haggaggot gevohot yoter measara o nemuchot yoter measara, delet leh lerabbi shimon eruve chatzerot ella mishshum kele habbayit:
Lakkelim sheshshavtu betochan. kelim sheshshavtu beachat mehen, motziim otan mizze laze:

Aval lo lakkelim sheshshavtu vetoch habbayit. vehevian lechatzer al yede sheervu bene hechatzer, asur lehotzian mechatzer zo lechatzer acheret im lo ervu shete hachatzerot yachad. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:

Eno holech letoch beto. dichtiv veyatza hakkohen min habbayit. yachol yelech leveto veyasgir, talmud lomar el petach habbayit, i el petach habbayit, yachol yaamod tachat hammashkof veyasgir, talmud lomar veyatza min habbayit, ad sheyyeaker mikkol habbayit:
Velo sid mikkol makom. dichtiv veafar acher yikkach, vesid lo have afar ella even serefa:
Lo achat tachat shetayim. even gedola shemmemallea mekom hashshetayim:

Mikkan amru oy larasha veoy lishcheno. sheim kotel mafsik ben shene vattim venira nega bakkotel letzad bayit ze, baal habbayit haacher tzarich lehittappel immo, dichtiv vechilletzu et haavanim, leshon rabbim. velaze shehannega letzad beto kore rasha, shehannegaim baim al lashon hara kedaamaran:
Shenehem kotzim. leshon veet habbayit yaktzia:
Yikkach vetach. leshon yachid, lemaote chavero sheen mittappel immo vatticha:

Biv. charitz heasuy kede sheyyekallechu hammayim [sheshshofchin] bechatzer lirshut harabbim. vehu kamur bemeshech arba ammot lirshut harabbim, divarba ammot yesh shiur livloa bahen satayim mayim sheadam mistappek bechol yom:
Shofchin letocho. detayme mayya veen yotzin lirshut harabbim:
Lo yishpoch al pi habbiv. dechevan divgavveh shafich mekalleche lehedya venafke lirshut harabbim, veharoe omer sheshshefachan samuch litziato lirshut harabbim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Mitztarfin learba ammot. im yesh bechatzer im haachsadra arba ammot al arba ammot mitztarfin, umuttar lishpoch letochah mayim veen tzarich uka:
Ad sheyyiggamer haddin. shel hanniddon sheyyehareg al pihen, veachar ken huzammu:
Veechad hamerubbe bivgadim. sheachar shennigneza tzelochit shel shemen hammishcha lo haya mitchannech lihyot kohen gadol ella vilvishat shemona vegadim:

Veechad sheavar mimmeshichato. sheera keri lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim uminnu acher tachtav. bemitat kol echad meellu hu chozer, af al pi shehaacher chay. deshalosh peamim kohen gadol ketiv bapparasha:

Rabbi yehuda omer af meshuach milchama. dikra acharina chetiv (Bamidbar la) lashuv lashevet baaretz ad mot hakkohen. verabbanan, kevan delo chetiv behahu kera hakkohen haggadol lo darshe leh. vahalacha kachachamim:
Shello yitpallelu al benehem sheyyamutu. vehem pashu, shehaya lahem levakkesh rachamim al doram shello yeera bahen takkala velo vikshu:
Mishshennigmar dino. legalut. demishshennigmar dino veomed legalut keillu gala:

Sanhedrin. hassemuchim baaretz, yesh lahen reshut ladun dine kenasot vedine nefashot, ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz, kol zeman sheyyesh bet din haggadol belishkat haggazit. shenneemar (Devarim 17) levilti shemoa el hakkohen o el hashshofet, bizman sheyyesh kohen makriv al gabbe mizbeach yesh shofet sheddan dine nefashot, bizman sheen kohen en shofet:
Sanhedrin hahoreget achat beshavua. achat lesheva shanim:
Nikret chovlanit. shetztzarich sheyyihyu metunim baddin, veyachziru vedine nefashot lizchut:

Lo neherag adam meolam. sheyyivdeku haedim bedavar shello yedu lehashiv. im rotzeach hu, ma reitem, terefa harag o shalem harag, veim timtza lomar shalem harag, shemma vimkom sayif nekev haya. veim megalle arayot hu, reitem kemichchol bashshefoferet:
Af hen marbim shofche damim. mittoch kach en mechallin harshaim umarbim lishpoch dam:
